analysis.insight: OR-Transformer利用物品排列等变Transformer架构捕捉跨物品依赖，并通过库存动态的路径梯度直接传播到连续订货量，解决了高维动作空间下的信用分配困难。共享固定成本导致订货动作的稀疏性（零或正数），连续动作RL方法难以处理，但通过专门设计的架构和训练方法可有效应对。其性能随规模增大而提升，表明等变性结构和直接梯度传播对大尺度问题具有关键作用。
limitations: 材料未明确陈述局限，但结论集中在较短的评估视界（如50决策和8决策），未见长期运行或实际部署验证
method: 神经网络输入：状态包括各物品净库存、在途订单、公共因子及问题参数向量
输出：每个物品的订货量（连续值），并通过判定是否为正来决定是否触发联合固定成本
架构：物品排列等变Transformer，处理整个物品集合以捕捉依赖
训练：通过库存动态的路径梯度直接训练连续订货量，实现端到端学习
策略执行：在滚动时域下，基于当前状态输出订单决策
analysis.motivation: 现代供应链运营需要协调数千种异质物品的补货，滚动时域随机MILP在如此规模下计算极其缓慢，而标准强化学习方法在高维动作空间中面临越来越棘手的信用分配问题。现有学习方法要么忽略共享固定成本耦合，要么在较小的动作维度下研究。
analysis.primary_topic: 基于深度强化学习的随机联合补货问题
analysis.relation_to_research: 本文属于AI4OR，利用深度强化学习优化联合补货问题，与生产调度中的资源分配和库存协同有相似之处。其等变Transformer架构和路径梯度训练方法可能迁移到具有共享资源或批次决策的调度问题（例如相似机器的批量调度）。推测：若调度中存在多个作业共享设置成本或资源，该架构需适配到动作空间的特性（如离散事件触发），可能需结合动作筛选；若调度空间具有置换等变性，则架构可直接应用。
analysis.setting: 研究随机联合补货问题（JRP），涉及n个异质物品，每个物品有持有成本、缺货成本、提前期和最大订购量，每次联合订货有共享固定成本；需求跨物品相关，且受观测的共同随机因子影响；目标是最小化折扣总成本。决策在每个时间步进行，决定是否下订单和每个物品的订货量；约束包括订货量上下界和缺货可积压。信息假设为基于当前库存、在途订单和公共因子的状态，环境是动态的随机环境，问题规模可达1024个物品，观测空间超过1e4维度。
analysis.title_zh: OR-Transformer：将实时决策扩展至1000个物品规模
analysis.uncertainty: 提取的信息全来自提供的摘要和部分正文（包括引言、问题公式、实验和结论），但缺少完整的实验细节，可能影响对方法的具体实现和局限的完整理解。作者单位基于作者标注，未提供通讯作者信息。
analysis.why_recommended: 本文展示了深度RL在大规模运筹问题（库存管理）中的潜力，通过架构和训练方法创新解决了高维动作空间和稀疏奖励的难题。其等变性设计和路径梯度方法对类似的大规模决策问题有借鉴价值，与强调可扩展性和实时性的调度优化研究紧密相关。

paper.abstract: Modern supply chain operations can require coordinating replenishment across thousands of heterogeneous items under correlated stochastic demand, heterogeneous lead times, and shared fixed ordering costs, yielding observation spaces exceeding $10^4$ dimensions. At this scale, rolling-horizon stochastic mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs) become prohibitively slow, while standard reinforcement learning (RL) methods face increasingly challenging credit assignment in high-dimensional action spaces. We introduce OR-Transformer, a deep reinforcement learning framework for joint replenishment under stochastic demand, with an item-permutation-equivariant Transformer architecture and pathwise-gradient training through the inventory dynamics. Across problem sizes up to 1,024 inventory items, OR-Transformer increasingly outperforms learning-based and rolling-horizon MILP baselines as scale grows. It also reduces online decision-making time by over 4 million times relative to MILP solvers, enabling real-time, large-scale deep RL in supply chain operations.
paper.title: OR-Transformer: Scaling Real-Time Decision-Making to 1,000 Items

analysis.analysis: 作者通过理论分析揭示了耦合组件的状态转移非可分离性，说明组件之间的交互效应不能通过单独优化每个组件来获得。作者将问题分解为两个相互关联的子问题：解初始化和惩罚构造，并通过联合生成策略确保它们在共享设计蓝图下兼容。实验通过消融研究验证跨组件兼容性和对齐优于独立组件重组。
challenges: 现有LLM增强的进化方法通常孤立地生成算法组件，忽略组件间的相互依赖关系
启发式设计高度依赖专家知识，手工设计难以适应不同问题实例
学习到的方法往往针对特定问题，缺乏跨实例迁移能力

evidence.claim: 现有的LLM增强进化方法通常单独进化算法组件，忽略组件间的相互依赖。
evidence.quote: existing large language model (LLM)-enhanced evolutionary methods typically evolve isolated algorithmic components, even when one determines the search state on which another operates.

evidence.claim: LLM-HCJG联合生成并共同进化相互依赖的启发式组件，应用于GLS，增强在线搜索机制。
evidence.quote: This paper proposes LLM-driven Heuristic Components Joint Generation (LLM-HCJG), a population-based framework that jointly generates and co-evolves interdependent heuristic components under a shared design blueprint. Applied to guided local search (GLS), LLM-HCJG couples solution initialization with penalty construction and embeds the generated pair into an enhanced online search mechanism.

evidence.claim: 理论分析建立了组件之间的非可分离状态转换效应，以及生成一致性的优势。
evidence.quote: Theoretical analysis establishes the non-separable state-transition effects between the two components and the advantage in generation consistency.

evidence.claim: 实验结果在TSPLIB和CVRPLIB上表现优异。
evidence.quote: LLM-HCJG attains consistently low optimality gaps, including best or tied-best results on 28 of 29 TSPLIB instances and all 12 CVRPLIB instances.

evidence.claim: 性能提升与跨组件兼容性相关，而不是孤立组件重组。
evidence.quote: Ablation and structural analyses further indicate that these gains are associated with cross-component compatibility and alignment rather than isolated-component recombination.

experiments: 作者在合成实例（20、50、100节点）和公共基准（TSPLIB中的29个实例和CVRPLIB中的12个实例）上测试，报告低的最优性差距。
在TSPLIB上，LLM-HCJG在28/29个实例上达到最佳或并列最佳；在CVRPLIB上，所有12个实例均达到最佳或并列最佳。
训练仅使用每个适应度评估5个训练实例，显示低成本训练。
消融和结构分析表明，性能提升与跨组件兼容性相关，而不仅是独立组件重组。
统计测试：引导95%置信区间高于零，配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验p<0.05，确认显著差异。
analysis.first_affiliation: 上海交通大学安泰经济与管理学院
analysis.insight: 核心洞察是启发式算法的组件之间存在非可分离的相互作用，联合生成和共同进化能够更好地保证组件间的兼容性和一致性，从而对GLS的搜索方向产生结构性影响，而非仅仅局部改进。这种整体性设计比起孤立进化单个组件更能发挥LLM的全局设计能力。
limitations: 未来计划包括扩展到更大和更异构的实例、与模型微调更紧密结合、以及扩展到其他元启发式框架。
材料未明确说明对于不同问题或更大规模实例的表现限制。
method: 提出LLM-HCJG框架，这是一个基于种群的进化方法，利用LLM作为变体生成器，在共同的蓝图下联合生成和共同进化三个耦合组件：解决方案初始化、惩罚构造以及增强的在线搜索机制（包括精英偏离、初始解重用、动态改进和定期恢复等固定机制）。
LLM-HCJG将GLS与所生成组件对结合，嵌入了增强的在线搜索机制，以利用耦合组件的协同效应，从而重塑GLS的搜索方向。
在进化过程中，每个个体由组件对表示，通过LLM提示驱动生成，并通过适应度评估（在训练实例上的性能）进行选择，实现共同进化。
生成的最终算法从TSP迁移到CVRP，展示了跨问题类型的泛化能力。
analysis.motivation: 传统启发式设计依赖专家知识，而现有的LLM增强进化方法通常孤立地进化算法组件，忽略了组件间的相互依赖关系（例如一个组件的输出决定另一个组件的搜索状态），导致整体性能受限。本文旨在通过联合生成和共同进化相互依赖的组件，提高自动设计启发式的效果，并实现跨实例的泛化。
analysis.primary_topic: 基于大语言模型的自动算法设计，联合进化相互依赖的启发式组件以改进引导局部搜索（GLS）
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文关注自动算法设计，方法是利用LLM和进化计算生成针对路由优化的启发式，这与智能优化和AI4OR直接相关，尤其是将学习与搜索结合来设计求解算法。在柔性作业车间调度或生产物流中，迁移的启发式设计思路可以应用于调度规则或元启发式的自适应组件参数调整，但与具体生产调度（如作业车间、流水车间）尚无直接应用。
analysis.setting: 本文针对组合优化中的路由问题（TSP和CVRP），决策对象是生成改进的GLS启发式算法，包括解初始化和惩罚构造两个相互依赖的组件。目标是自动设计高质量启发式策略。关键约束是生成的组件需嵌入GLS框架并保证可行性。信息假设：静态、确定性的路由实例，材料未说明动态或不确定性。环境为离线的进化搜索过程，生成后的算法在实例上测试。
analysis.title_zh: 面向路由优化的耦合启发式组件的LLM驱动联合进化
analysis.uncertainty: 材料未提供摘要和节选之外的详细实验数据，例如具体最优性差距或可复现性指标，评估准确性受限。此外，部分方法细节（如提示设计）在正文中可能未完全覆盖。
analysis.why_recommended: 本文提出了一个新颖的联合启发式组件进化框架，强调了组件间协同优化的重要性，这对于研究生产调度中的动态调度策略或分布式制造中的协同优化有直接启发。其理论分析和验证方法也值得借鉴。

paper.abstract: Heuristic design for combinatorial optimization remains heavily reliant on expert knowledge, while existing large language model (LLM)-enhanced evolutionary methods typically evolve isolated algorithmic components, even when one determines the search state on which another operates. This paper proposes LLM-driven Heuristic Components Joint Generation (LLM-HCJG), a population-based framework that jointly generates and co-evolves interdependent heuristic components under a shared design blueprint. Applied to guided local search (GLS), LLM-HCJG couples solution initialization with penalty construction and embeds the generated pair into an enhanced online search mechanism. The resulting form is further transferred from the traveling salesman problem (TSP) to the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP). Theoretical analysis establishes the non-separable state-transition effects between the two components and the advantage in generation consistency. Across synthetic instances and 41 public TSPLIB/CVRPLIB benchmarks, LLM-HCJG attains consistently low optimality gaps, including best or tied-best results on 28 of 29 TSPLIB instances and all 12 CVRPLIB instances. Ablation and structural analyses further indicate that these gains are associated with cross-component compatibility and alignment rather than isolated-component recombination. These results support effective cross-instance transfer within the evaluated routing settings under limited-sample, modest-cost training.
paper.title: LLM-Driven Joint Evolution of Coupled Heuristics Components for Routing Optimization

analysis.analysis: 作者未明确阐述，但推测：利用多梯度聚合思想构造下降方向，正则化参数根据投影步长自适应更新，使用基于法锥的证书确保下降性，结合SAA梯度的相合性建立样本复杂度。材料未说明更详细的分解或问题结构利用。

method: 初始化可行点与正则化参数。
每轮迭代计算一个可行的正则化多梯度步，即结合各目标样本梯度信息构造方向，并投影到可行集。
基于投影步长更新正则化参数，实现自适应。
利用法锥证书估计帕累托平稳性残差，并得出复杂度界。
证明SAA梯度相合性，将有限样本残差转化为总体问题的帕累托平稳性，并给出紧集上的有限样本残差界。
analysis.motivation: 实际中的多目标优化问题常涉及随机性或噪声，目标函数为期望形式，难以获得精确梯度和函数值。现有方法可能依赖于函数值或线搜索，而许多应用只有样本梯度，因此需要一种无需线搜索和函数值的自适应投影梯度算法，同时需要理论保证收敛性和样本复杂度。

analysis.relation_to_research: 论文研究随机多目标优化，属于多目标约束优化的理论算法，但问题是连续凸集上的随机优化，与智能优化中的多目标进化算法、神经网络辅助求解的离散组合优化不同。其投影梯度框架和SAA分析可启发处理随机目标的生产调度问题中的多目标松弛，但迁移需满足梯度可用且决策空间为连续凸集等条件，推测较难直接用于组合调度。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为在非空闭凸集上的随机多目标优化，每个目标函数是期望形式，且仅可获得样本梯度信息。目标是寻找帕累托平稳点。决策变量属于闭凸集，约束为集合约束，没有其他显式约束。信息假设为仅有样本梯度，无函数值。环境为静态，涉及批量样本的均值近似。

paper.abstract: We consider stochastic multi-objective optimization over a nonempty closed convex set, where every objective is an expectation and only sample-gradient information is available. We develop a line-search-free and function-value-free adaptive projected-gradient algorithm for the sample-average approximation (SAA) problem. Each iteration computes a feasible regularized multi-gradient step and updates the regularization parameter from the projected step length. A normal-cone-based certificate yields descent estimates and an explicit complexity bound for the Pareto-stationarity residual of the SAA problem. The consistency of SAA gradients then transfers vanishing SAA residuals to Pareto stationarity for the population problem, while an additional concentration argument gives a finite-sample residual bound on compact sets. Experiments on synthetic problems, classification, portfolio selection, multi-task learning, and robot control illustrate the practical performance of our algorithm.
paper.title: An Adaptive Projected-Gradient Algorithm for Sample-Average Approximations of Stochastic Multi-Objective Optimization

paper.abstract: Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization (GP-BO) excels at black-box optimization of costly functions, e.g., hyperparameter optimization (HPO) and multi-agent system (MAS) design. Convergence-rate guarantees exist for select methods, notably GP upper confidence bound (GP-UCB), but require a fixed kernel. Critically, the kernel encodes how input proximity affects objective value similarity. When raw coordinates poorly match this geometry - as with log-scaled hyperparameters or localized peaks - input warping can greatly improve sample efficiency, yet known GP-UCB proofs require a fixed kernel. We propose Finite-Library Input-Warped Bayesian Optimization (FLIWBO), which selects warps from a finite library of smooth input maps by any history-dependent rule. It adapts the input geometry to accelerate learning while retaining high-probability convergence guarantees under mild hypotheses, with an explicit $\sqrt(N_\varepsilon)$ library-size cost. Controlled diagnostics show that finite-library warping repairs planted geometry mismatches and identify FLIWBO failure cases. Across four repeated benchmarks - warped synthetic objectives, a confidence-fence trap, and Fashion-MNIST HPO - FLIWBO-UCB beats raw-coordinate GP-UCB under misspecified geometry, escapes traps that defeat even oracle-warp expected improvement, and recovers much of the gain from manual log scaling, while leading the tested methods that admit a matching regret guarantee. A 20-dimensional MAS design study further shows feasibility under costly noisy evaluations. Code for experiments is available: https://github.com/edvin-ketabati/bogp-paper-experiments.
paper.title: No-Regret Bayesian Optimization with Finite-Library Input-Warped Kernels

analysis.analysis: 作者通过实证审计分析了学习型调度器的脆弱性。他们以ASSENT算法为例，评估GNN输出解集的可行性，发现高F1分数掩盖了大量不可行解。他们提出可行性投影（如贪心修复）可恢复可行性且效用损失低。进一步，他们研究了虚假数据注入攻击，并区分了针对目标函数和针对约束的攻击，通过跨AP一致性检查检测约束伪造。

单恶意AP无法大幅增加其用户关联，但能大幅提高不可行解的比例。
针对约束的虚假报告无法通过投影缓解，但可通过跨AP一致性检查检测（约99.5%检测率，约1%误报）。

experiments: 在ASSENT系统上评估，网络规模为8个AP、10个用户、4个目标。
高F1分数下约有70%-74%的解违反硬约束。
可行性投影恢复可行性且效用损失<0.1%。
一致性检查检测攻击的概率约99.5%（范围99%-100%），误报率约1%，且将残余不可行率从12%降至4%。
analysis.insight: 高预测精度（如F1分数）不能保证联合可行性，可行性与安全性是独立的属性。可行性投影能恢复约束满足但可能被攻击者利用：若攻击影响目标函数则投影可缓解，若影响约束则投影反而会放大攻击效果。因此，评估学习型调度器需要约束感知的可行性度量，并考虑报告信道安全的威胁。
limitations: 实证评估局限于所述系统拓扑（8 AP, 10用户, 4目标）。
评估大型网络需要计算昂贵的精确求解器生成新训练标签，因此可扩展性验证留作未来工作。
method: 使用GNN作为学习型调度器，输入为轻量级AP统计量，输出为聚类、调度和模式决策。
训练时使用MILP标签，约束作为软惩罚；推理时输出可能不可行。
可行性投影：采用贪心修复过程将GNN输出投影到可行解。
针对FDI攻击：分析误报目标函数或约束参数的影响，并提出低复杂度跨AP一致性检查以检测攻击。
analysis.motivation: 学习型调度器通过GNN在单次前向传播中输出关联决策，以绕过MILP求解的计算瓶颈。但硬约束仅在训练中作为软惩罚，导致推理时可能违反约束；且系统依赖AP上报的统计量，易受错误数据注入攻击。本文旨在实证审计这些脆弱性，强调约束感知的评估指标和安全性。

analysis.relation_to_research: 论文核心是评估学习型调度器的约束可行性和安全性。与智能优化和生产调度关系为：它研究了学习（GNN）辅助求解中硬约束处理的核心问题，以及可行性投影机制。对生产调度，可推测类似风险：基于学习的调度器可能因软约束处理产生不可行解，且数据不确定性可能影响约束满足。迁移需考虑生产调度中的约束特性（如资源、时间窗）和报告可信度。

analysis.why_recommended: 该研究展示了学习型调度器在约束可行性与安全性的实证分析，为AI4OR研究者提供范式：高精度不保证可行性，需要约束感知评估。其可行性投影和攻击分析可启发智能优化方法中的鲁棒性和真实性设计。

paper.abstract: Learning-based schedulers have been proposed to provide real-time user, target, and access point (AP) association in distributed cell-free integrated sensing and communication systems. In a typical approach, a graph neural network (GNN), trained on labels from a mixed-integer linear program, maps lightweight per-AP statistics to decisions on AP clustering, user and target scheduling, and mode selection in one forward pass. Such solutions assume that hard constraints, enforced only as soft training penalties, hold at inference, and that the self-reported statistics are truthful. Using our ASSENT algorithm as an example, we find that despite high $F_1$ scores, many solutions violate at least one hard constraint, demonstrating that high prediction accuracy does not ensure joint feasibility. Projecting the GNN output onto a feasible solution restores constraint satisfaction with low utility loss, even with a simple greedy repair procedure. We further show that feasibility alone does not guarantee robustness to false data injection attacks. A single malicious AP that reports false information cannot substantially increase its user associations, but can greatly increase the rate of infeasible solutions. The effect of such attacks depends on the type of information being falsified. Misreporting information that affects the objective can largely be mitigated through feasibility projection, whereas falsifying information that affects the constraints cannot. The latter can, however, be detected using a low-complexity cross-AP consistency check. These results show that learned ISAC schedulers should be evaluated using constraint-aware feasibility metrics in addition to conventional accuracy measures.

paper.title: Feasible but Not Safe: Constraint Violations and Report-Channel Attacks in Learned Cell-Free ISAC Association

paper.abstract: The objective of the resource-constrained project scheduling problem (RCPSP) is to minimize makespan while satisfying precedence and renewable-resource constraints. Priority-rule heuristics construct feasible schedules with low computational cost and explicit decision logic, making them widely used in practice and an attractive alternative to more computationally intensive methods. However, no traditional rule performs consistently well across projects, and researchers have therefore investigated automated priority-rule design. Genetic programming (GP) hyper-heuristics have been the predominant approach to this task, but evolving a high-performing rule may require evaluating many candidate rules on the training projects. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) make it possible to generate and iteratively revise priority rules using performance feedback. This paper presents an LLM-guided population-based framework for automated priority-rule design. During the offline search, an LLM generates and revises candidate rules, while schedule quality on training projects determines candidate fitness and guides subsequent revisions. At the end of the search, the best rule is returned and applied directly to unseen projects without further search or LLM calls. Experiments show that the LLM-designed rules outperform traditional single rules across the test sets and outperform GP-designed rules obtained under comparable search effort, while remaining competitive with rules obtained from a substantially larger GP search. On large projects, selected LLM-designed rules outperform all considered traditional rules and two genetic algorithm configurations on highly parallel projects. An ablation study examines how changes to the main search components affect performance, while rule analyses describe the structure and decision behavior of the LLM-designed rules.

paper.abstract: We study the job shop scheduling problem with a conflict graph (JSC), in which adjacent jobs in the conflict graph cannot be processed simultaneously on different machines, with the objective of minimizing the makespan. The problem models settings where jobs share additional resources while retaining their individual machine routings. We first investigate its computational complexity and establish a polynomial equivalence between JSC and a variant of the resource-constrained job shop problem with unit-capacity resources. Although the general problem on two machines is NP-hard, we identify a polynomially solvable special case. For the general problem, we develop precedence-based and time-indexed mixed-integer linear formulations, along with lower bounds on the makespan. We also propose a genetic algorithm using permutation-with-repetition encoding and active, non-delay, and hybrid schedule evaluation procedures. Computational experiments on instances derived from the Lawrence and Taillard benchmarks, as well as randomly generated generalized job shop instances, are conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed formulations, lower bounds, and genetic algorithm.
paper.title: Minimizing the makespan in job shop scheduling under conflict graph constraints

paper.abstract: Graph coarsening reduces the large Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) formulations arising when vehicle-routing problems are solved by quantum annealing. Nearby customers with compatible time windows are merged into super-nodes, the reduced problem is solved, and the solution is expanded to the original graph. For the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW), existing coarsening heuristics require family-specific tuning and remain unreliable on random instances. We address these limitations on the Solomon benchmark using simulated annealing and a D-Wave Advantage2 processor. We first introduce adaptive penalty calibration. Uniform penalty scaling has little effect, whereas controlling the internal coefficient range substantially improves raw samples. Removing non-binding constraints, normalising binding ones, and scaling the remaining penalties reduces mean raw constraint violations from 33.0 to 0.06 at the same solver budget (p=3.7e-11, n=56). A variable-count-preserving control attributes this gain to conditioning rather than problem size. Second, we replace the hand-tuned merge score with a graph neural network (GNN) using one configuration across all families. At N=10, it achieves 100% feasibility across all Solomon families, including R-type (100% vs. 80% for the tuned heuristic). Across N=10,...,100, feasibility is 83% vs. 69%, with the GNN better or tied on 85/90 instance-size pairs. At N=80,100, the difference is significant (p=0.002; 25/25 pairs), while the QUBO remains approximately 5-6 times smaller. Finally, hardware experiments reproduce the conditioning effect at fixed logical variable count: feasible samples increase from 0.02% to 39% across 13 instances. Classical repair with local search remains a reference bound for end-to-end solution cost.
paper.title: GNN-Guided Graph Coarsening and Adaptive QUBO Penalties for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows on a Quantum Annealer

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to formulate optimization models from natural-language problem descriptions, yet realistic operations research (OR) requests are often incomplete: missing objectives, constraints, or business rules can change the resulting mathematical program. Existing evaluations largely assume a complete specification and therefore overlook whether an agent knows when clarification is needed before modeling. We introduce OR-Clarify, a benchmark for pre-formulation clarification. Each task presents a partial public problem description, withholds structured hidden slots, and evaluates agents through bounded interaction with a simulated user. The benchmark supports both openended and choice-based clarification, and measures slot recovery, stopping behavior, silent assumptions, and interaction cost. We further propose Interactive Optimization (InterOPT), a two-stage framework that identifies unresolved formulation-critical gaps and uses them to guide whether to ask the next question or to stop. In our choice-based experiments, InterOPT substantially outperforms all baselines in exact slot recovery; in the open-ended setting, it remains competitive with strong prior methods. Together, OR-Clarify and InterOPT reframe OR assistance as a selective completeness decision: clarify when needed, stop when ready, and quantify what remains missing.
paper.title: Ask Before You Optimize: Dynamic Pre-Formulation Clarification for Interactive Optimization

analysis.analysis: 作者采用基于单元的网络表示，将道路划分为细粒度单元以匹配感知范围；设计单元级时空覆盖度量指标；利用单元传输模型（CTM）进行交通状态预测，并据此生成时变行驶时间成本；将路由优化建模为混合整数线性规划（MILP），在滚动时域方案中求解。

监控性能指标设计：需要能够直接反映监控质量、可由个体车辆计算、并在网络层面有意义的指标。
时变动态决策：路由决策必须实时适应交通状态与网络可观测性变化，计算复杂度与实时性挑战。

结果显示，将时空覆盖纳入目标函数能有效提高监控性能。

analysis.insight: 核心洞察是将交通监控性能（时空覆盖）显式纳入路径规划目标，可以引导车队绕行以覆盖未观测区域，而并非必然牺牲平均速度。在适当权重下，监控性能与平均速度可以同时提升，原因是更好的覆盖提高了交通状态预测精度，进而改善了出行时间估计和路径选择。
limitations: 材料表示，增加覆盖并不单调地提高车队感知能力，过度的路由预算导致仅增加行驶距离而速度下降，部署需权衡。

MILP 公式：目标函数同时最小化总行驶时间和最大化监控性能，受路由可行性和服务约束（材料未详细说明）。
滚动时域方案：动态路由算法随时间重复求解以响应交通状态变化。
微观仿真集成：利用 SUMO 模拟机器人出租车和背景车辆运动，基于车辆观测预测交通状态并反馈给路由优化。
analysis.motivation: 传统固定式传感器空间覆盖有限且成本高；探测车数据受个人出行需求驱动且不可控，且需要高市场渗透率才能保证足够的时空覆盖。机器人出租车作为新兴车队，既可为乘客服务，又可作为感知平台，若能将其路由决策与监控目标集成，有潜力实现网络级交通监控。

analysis.relation_to_research: 该研究与智能优化和运筹优化相关，因为采用了混合整数线性规划和滚动时域方法求解动态路由问题。研究设定中，交通状态预测与路由优化迭代相互影响，类似于数据驱动的闭环决策。尽管未涉及生产调度或柔性作业车间，但其将传感器覆盖质量作为显式优化目标的思想可迁移至诸如机器人移动充电、巡检调度或具有数据采集功能的车辆路径问题。这是推测性的迁移，需要明确目标函数的平衡权重与可行性约束的适应性。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是在城市路网中，利用机器人出租车队作为移动传感器进行交通监控，同时提供出行服务。决策对象是机器人出租车的动态路径，优化目标为最小化总出行时间并最大化监控性能（时空覆盖）。关键约束包括车辆运动学、乘客需求（材料未明确说明）、以及路由决策必须适应实时交通状态。信息假设为部分可观测，交通状态通过车辆观测预测。环境为动态的，基于滚动时域的微观仿真。

paper.abstract: Urban traffic monitoring plays a critical role in safety analysis, congestion management, and incident response. The growing deployment of robotaxis creates a new opportunity for network-level traffic monitoring. Although robotaxis are primarily designed to serve passengers, they can also be leveraged as drive-by sensors to collect traffic data. Compared to conventional infrastructure sensors or probe vehicles, a fleet of robotaxis forms a cooperative perception environment, which can collectively gather spatially and temporally continuous traffic information. This paper proposes a novel dynamic robotaxi routing framework that explicitly incorporates traffic monitoring tasks as an objective. The framework introduces: (1) a cell-based network representation that aligns with sensing capabilities of robotaxis; (2) a cell-level monitoring metric to quantify spatiotemporal robotaxi coverage; and (3) a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) formulation that jointly minimizes time-dependent travel time and maximizes traffic monitoring performance. A 5 by 5 urban grid network is built in SUMO to evaluate the framework under three robotaxi market penetration rates (2%, 5%, and 10%) with a range of objective weight combinations. Results show that incorporating spatiotemporal network coverage in the objective function can effectively improve the traffic monitoring performance. Interestingly, with appropriate weights between the two objectives, monitoring performance and robotaxi average speed can be improved simultaneously. This suggests better network monitoring leads to more accurate traffic state prediction and improved mobility. This win-win situation could incentivize robotaxi operators to contribute their vehicles as drive-by sensors for traffic monitoring.
paper.title: RoboSense: Leveraging Robotaxi Fleets as Drive-by Sensors for Urban Traffic Monitoring

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文直接研究多智能体运输规划中的任务分配、调度与路径规划联合优化，使用混合整数线性规划与 anytime 求解器，并关注吞吐量目标、比例约束与可扩展性。这与智能优化、生产调度和 AI4OR 中的多智能体协同、约束可行性、求解质量与公平计算预算等议题相邻。迁移到柔性作业车间、流水车间或生产运输协同属于推测，需要把放矿比例约束替换为工序与机器能力约束、把矿车车队替换为工件与运输设备，并验证 MILP 表述与子周期分解在该结构下是否仍具可扩展性。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为地下块状崩落采矿场景下的运输规划，决策对象是自动驾驶矿车车队，目标是在满足放矿比例（draw ratio）约束的前提下最大化矿石吞吐量，需同时决定任务分配、调度与路径规划；环境被描述为动态矿山环境，但摘要未说明扰动的具体形式、车辆动力学约束、时间窗或通信假设，也未说明是静态还是在线动态求解，这些要素材料未说明。
analysis.title_zh: 块状崩落采矿中最终最优且可扩展的多智能体规划
analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据标题与摘要分析，无法获知具体 MILP 变量与约束、实验基线、实例规模、运行时间与最优性间隙，也无法确认动态扰动的处理方式，因此对其方法细节和实验强度的判断存在不确定性。
analysis.why_recommended: 该工作展示了用统一 MILP 表述联合处理任务分配、调度与路径规划，并通过子周期分解在最优性与可扩展性之间取舍，其 anytime 求解思路、约束驱动的联合建模方式对生产调度与生产运输协同问题具有方法参考价值；同时提醒研究者关注求解保证与规模之间的权衡。

paper.abstract: Automation in underground mining has the potential to significantly enhance safety, operational efficiency, and sustainability. However, effectively coordinating fleets of autonomous vehicles in dynamic mine environments introduces substantial challenges in both optimization and motion planning. To address these challenges, we introduce and formalize the \emph{Block Cave Mining (BCM)} problem, which focuses on computing a transport plan that maximizes ore throughput while satisfying draw ratio constraints. To solve this problem, we propose SAMM, an eventually optimal anytime solver that jointly integrates task assignment, scheduling, and path planning via a mixed-integer linear programming formulation. To improve scalability, we also introduce SAMMS, a variant of SAMM that trades optimality guarantees for efficiency by decomposing the problem into shorter planning subcycles. Experimental evaluations using realistic industrial mine scenarios demonstrate that SAMMS achieves near-optimal throughput and scales effectively to larger fleets and mine layouts.
paper.title: Eventually Optimal and Scalable Multi-Agent Planning for Block Cave Mining

analysis.analysis: 作者采用解析和数值结合的分析方法。首先，他们意识到由于非凸性，标量化产生的局部最优构成整个解结构的骨架，因此提出通过生成受控拓扑的局部最优和延拓方法来绘制局部非支配曲线。其次，他们通过两轮数值实验分析曲线结构：第一轮在悬臂梁例子中揭示拓扑复杂性和对称性的影响，验证了连续性、平滑性和凸性等性质；第二轮针对数值不稳定性，将缺乏唯一性与优化景观的平坦性关联，将不连续性归因于分岔现象，并类比亚临界对称破缺叉形分岔进行解释，从而从理论上阐明曲线断裂的根本原因。

paper.abstract: This paper studies the nondominated set for topology optimization of compliance and volume. In the multiobjective topology optimization literature, scalarization is a popular method to approximate this set, which is better known as the Pareto frontier. However, previous work indicates that the pointwise approximation obtained by scalarization obfuscates its underlying mathematical structure: under an imposed length scale, it consists of locally nondominated curve segments. To investigate this structure, the paper uses a simple methodology to (i) generate local optima with a tightly controlled topology and (ii) use continuation to extend these points to locally nondominated curves. The paper then performs two rounds of numerical experiments. The first round applies the methodology to several cantilever examples. This leads to novel insights regarding topological complexity and symmetry and confirms prior conclusions regarding continuity, smoothness and convexity. The second round investigates two numerical instabilities: (i) a lack of uniqueness and (ii) discontinuities of the locally nondominated curves. The former is linked to an observed flatness of the optimization landscape, whereas the latter is attributed to branch splitting and linked to bifurcation theory. Namely, we classify these discontinuities as higher-dimensional analogues of the subcritical, symmetry-breaking pitchfork bifurcation. The paper concludes with suggestions for future research to address these features of the multiobjective optimization landscape.
paper.title: Mapping locally nondominated curves in multiobjective topology optimization of compliance and volume

paper.abstract: Mathematical programming provides a common language for many decisions embedded in modern machine-learning (ML) and artificial-intelligence (AI) systems: selecting retrieval context, routing tokens, allocating inference compute, fitting structured predictors, protecting against distribution shift, and balancing competing objectives. However, the relevant literature is fragmented across optimization, information retrieval, recommendation, natural-language processing, computer vision, and learning theory. This paper organizes various applications under common mathematical programming paradigms: linear, quadratic, binary and mixed-integer, conic, bilevel, multi-objective, inverse, distributionally robust, submodular, and min--max optimization. We normalize the models with a mostly unified notation and, for every application, identify inputs, decision variables, a principal formulation, structural properties, solution strategies, and limitations. Across paradigms, we compare tractability, relaxation quality, decomposition, approximation guarantees, and scalability bottlenecks. The paper shows that mathematical programming is most useful not as a claim that all learning is LP or MIP, but as a disciplined interface between predictions and constrained decisions.
paper.title: Mathematical Programming in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence: A Unified Taxonomy of Models and Applications

paper.abstract: City logistics addresses the design and management of efficient freight transportation in urban areas. Two-tier networks, where goods are moved by different vehicle fleets from distribution centers to customers using intermediate consolidation facilities, are particularly effective. Although studied from routing, location, and network design perspectives, the research progress is slowed by the lack of standardized, state-of-the-art benchmark data. Many studies rely on outdated and artificial or case-specific instances, limiting reproducibility, comparability, and generality of results. To address this gap, we identify general problem characteristics for two-tier city logistics, provide an instance generation framework CLInstGen that is applicable to a wide range of problem settings, and propose the first benchmark library CLLIB. The library and the CLInstGen code are open-source, allowing researchers to easily use, adapt, and generate instances for their specific applications. CLLIB is based on real-world geographies of urban regions and provides a curated collection of standardized instances for direct benchmarking of models and methods as well as statistical evaluation. A computational study with two different problem settings, namely tactical service network design on two tiers and vehicle routing with simultaneous pickups and deliveries on a single tier, confirms the versatility of both the generator and the library, and provides first numerical and managerial insights on the CLLIB benchmark instances.
paper.title: CLInstGen: An Instance Generation Framework for Two-Tier City Logistics

paper.abstract: Battery cell design must balance energy density, fast charging, and degradation, yet these metrics evolve over different time scales and are costly to optimize jointly. We develop a timescale-aware surrogate-assisted framework that evaluates beginning-of-life volumetric energy density and 10--80% charging time together with state-of-health (SOH) loss over 200 cycles. Physics-based simulations of 1501 cell designs generate 1427 quality-controlled samples across 12 manufacturing-relevant parameters. Objective-specific surrogates support total-order Sobol analysis, which reveals distinct parameter rankings across the three metrics. A cross-objective rank-union strategy then retains variables influential to at least one objective before evolutionary Pareto optimization. Re-evaluation of the optimized candidates using the original physics-based models confirms designs that outperform the reference cell in all three metrics. Among these jointly improving candidates, the objective-wise best solutions, attained by different designs, can reduce SOH loss by 99.31%, increase volumetric energy density by 12.49%, and shorten charging time by 28.73%. The framework makes Pareto exploration across disparate electrochemical timescales computationally tractable, thereby enabling systematic multi-objective optimization of battery cell design.
paper.title: Timescale-aware surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization of battery cell design for energy density, fast charging, and degradation

analysis.analysis: 作者将SMPC问题转化为学习任务，通过生成多个候选轨迹并结合可行性验证与选择来保证可行性。利用条件随机生成器输出多个候选，并以自监督损失塑形分布，鼓励多样性、可行性与经济性。引入约束感知的可微架构，用投影机制精确强制框和爬坡约束，并用可微等式补全代理重构潮流，保留物理关系以增强泛化能力。
challenges: 非线性非凸交流潮流约束下SMPC的可行性与经济性难以平衡
现有神经网络代理在激活边界附近存在梯度消失或梯度阻断，削弱训练信号
软惩罚无法保证推理时的可行性，而外部求解器修复增加计算负担
高维问题中预测内点投影的有效性难以维持

evidence.claim: 提出生成多个候选轨迹的方法以提高可行性
evidence.quote: To address this limitation, a conditional stochastic neural generator (CSNG) is developed to produce multiple candidate dispatch trajectories for each uncertainty instance, enabling the recovery of a feasible and economical solution through candidate selection.

evidence.claim: 采用自监督分布塑形避免昂贵的SMPC标签
evidence.quote: A feasibility-aware self-supervised distribution-shaping scheme is further introduced to promote constraint satisfaction, candidate diversity, and operating economy without requiring computationally expensive SMPC solution labels, while mitigating candidate collapse in generative ACOPF learning.

evidence.claim: 在IEEE 14和118节点系统上实验成功
evidence.quote: Case studies on the IEEE 14- and 118-bus systems demonstrate $100\%$ feasibility, optimality gaps below $2\%$, and computational efficiency suitable for intraday dispatch.

experiments: IEEE 14节点和118节点系统，16个时段，每时段15分钟，20个不确定性场景。
CSNG在测试集上达到100%可行率，最优性间隙低于2%（具体为0.80%）。
与确定性D-NN（可行率46.2%）对比，CSNG显著提高可行率并保持经济性。
消融实验显示，约束感知投影（对比sigmoid参数化）将最优性间隙从1.79%降至0.80%，多样性保持项改善可行性与经济性。
DECS的近似精度：平均绝对残差在7.77e-5到2.97e-3之间，95%分位数误差低于9.40e-3，可行性分类一致率在99.92%到100%之间。
推理时DECS仅用于训练，在线决策通过原始潮流方程验证，结果不影响可靠性。
计算效率适用于日内调度（在线时间主要取决于并行潮流计算，K=100时计算时间为27.08秒）。

analysis.insight: 通过生成多个候选调度轨迹而非单一预测，为每个不确定性实例提供多次机会恢复可行且经济的解，从而在生成式学习中提高可行性。利用自监督分布塑形策略，无需昂贵的SMPC求解标签即可引导候选解向多样、可行且经济的区域分布，缓解候选坍缩问题。
limitations: 材料未明确陈述局限，但可能受限于候选数量K与计算资源的权衡，以及DECS仅在训练时使用但依赖其近似精度。
method: 条件随机神经生成器（CSNG）：接收不确定性实例，生成多个候选调度轨迹（例如K个），通过候选选择恢复可行且经济的解。
可行性感知的自监督分布塑形：设计损失函数，无需标注SMPC解，鼓励约束满足、候选多样性与经济性，并缓解生成式ACOPF学习中的候选坍缩。

可微等式补全代理（DECS）：离线预训练替代交流潮流求解，用于训练阶段的可微约束反馈；推理时仍使用原始潮流方程验证可行性。

paper.abstract: This paper proposes an end-to-end generative framework for efficiently solving multi-period and multi-scenario stochastic model predictive control (SMPC) problems under nonlinear AC power-flow constraints. Conventional deterministic neural surrogates rely on a single-shot prediction, which makes reliable feasibility difficult to achieve because one dispatch trajectory must simultaneously satisfy nonlinear constraints across all scenarios and time periods. To address this limitation, a conditional stochastic neural generator (CSNG) is developed to produce multiple candidate dispatch trajectories for each uncertainty instance, enabling the recovery of a feasible and economical solution through candidate selection. A feasibility-aware self-supervised distribution-shaping scheme is further introduced to promote constraint satisfaction, candidate diversity, and operating economy without requiring computationally expensive SMPC solution labels, while mitigating candidate collapse in generative ACOPF learning. To support efficient end-to-end training, a constraint-aware differentiable architecture is introduced. It employs a projection mechanism to exactly enforce box and ramping constraints while preserving informative gradients near active bounds, together with a differentiable equality-completion surrogate for efficient AC power-flow reconstruction. Case studies on the IEEE 14- and 118-bus systems demonstrate $100\%$ feasibility, optimality gaps below $2\%$, and computational efficiency suitable for intraday dispatch. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/JieZhu6/Generative_SMPC.
paper.title: Stochastic Model Predictive Control under AC Power-Flow Constraints Using Generative Learning

paper.abstract: The rise of privacy-preserving artificial intelligence (AI) has shifted the focus of model adaptation and personalization towards on-device learning, where deep learning models are finetuned directly on edge hardware using local user data. However, this shift requires optimization of deep learning training on resource-constrained hardware to maximize throughput while maintaining predictive accuracy. This paper introduces a novel technique for on-device model training that incorporates an efficient Bayesian optimization-based batch size tuning approach to maximize hardware throughput. To evaluate the impact of this hyperparameter on the learning dynamics, we investigated two distinct paradigms: standard supervised learning (SL) and online continual learning (CL). Experimental results across various edge devices demonstrate a throughput ceiling, beyond which increasing the batch size yields no additional throughput gains. The proposed tuning approach identifies the optimal batch size, which, when combined with gradient accumulation and linear learning rate scaling, achieves up to a 2X increase in training throughput on platforms such as Raspberry Pi 4 compared to maximum batch sizes, without compromising model accuracy. Furthermore, in the CL paradigm, we demonstrate that optimal batch sizes maintain the stability-plasticity balance required for incremental learning, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting while maximizing computational efficiency on edge-hardware.

paper.abstract: We study the use of graph neural networks (GNNs) for finding approximate ground states of Ising models. Efficiently finding these ground states is of broad significance because many combinatorial optimization problems can be formulated as an Ising model with the appropriate choice of couplings and fields. Exactly solving these problems is hard but there are many good heuristic methods. A lineage of these heuristics build from mean-field approximations: one approach uses the leading eigenvector of an appropriately defined matrix, another is the min-sum algorithm, also known as the energetic cavity method. Without modification, GNNs perform worse than both of these methods. We consider small modifications to the GNN to incorporate these heuristics and find that this considerably improves performance. While the modified approach is competitive against other deep-learning approaches, we still find that simulated annealing is reliably at least as good as deep learning methods for the same computational cost.
paper.title: Graph neural networks and the energetic cavity method for combinatorial optimization

paper.abstract: Offline multi-objective optimization requires not only moving the objective vectors of candidate designs toward the Pareto front, but also distributing them effectively along it. Generative methods have recently emerged as a natural approach because they learn a distribution over feasible designs while allowing generation to be steered toward promising designs. Existing methods, however, largely retain classical sample-wise guidance strategies, leaving the distribution-level modeling capability of generative methods underused. We propose ParetoTransport, a training-free guidance method for pre-trained flow-matching models that explicitly specifies and refines a population-level distribution in objective space. ParetoTransport guides a flow-matching sampler to iteratively transport the empirical offline distribution toward the Pareto front, with Wasserstein matching to intermediate proxy distributions. This directly controls distributional displacement and mass allocation along the front. We establish a convergence result and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on standard offline MOO benchmarks, extending recent evaluations beyond hypervolume to generational distance, inverted generational distance, and Wasserstein distance.
paper.title: ParetoTransport: Generative Optimization by Mass Transport Toward The Pareto Front

paper.abstract: Greedy algorithms efficiently approximate combinatorial optimization problems, but their guarantees weaken when feasibility couples combinatorial structure with global physical constraints. We study monotone nondecreasing supermodular minimization over the bases of a graphic greedoid under physics-induced constraints. We model physics-informed selection using a look-ahead oracle that identifies candidates extendable to a feasible basis, yielding the Conditioned Sequential Greedy Algorithm. We derive a closed-form approximation bound, which we call the price of feasibility, based on the variability of oracle-restricted candidate sets and a probabilistic correction for unobserved elements. As a case study, we show that FORWARD, an algorithm for multi-source radial network reconfiguration, instantiates this framework. Numerical results demonstrate the tightness of the bound and quantify the feasibility-optimality trade-off.
paper.title: The Price of Feasibility: Greedy Approximation Bounds for String Supermodular Optimization over Oracle-Conditioned Greedoids

analysis.analysis: 作者从优化遗憾视角分析两类神经求解器的误差缩放行为，指出RL求解器的遗憾随horizon复合增长而扩散求解器的遗憾随剩余子空间维度增长，两者具有互补结构。基于此建立统一的误差缩放理论框架，在显式误差缩放假设下证明混合结构严格低于任一骨干的期望遗憾，并证明存在唯一最优触发步使混合遗憾最小化。由于最优触发步不可在单条轨迹上直接计算，作者转而利用轨迹级信号作为实际代理。

evidence.quote: We propose Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization (HyCO), a hybrid inference algorithm that constructs a solution prefix with an RL solver and adaptively switches to a conditional DM to complete the remaining decisions.

evidence.claim: 论文建立统一误差缩放理论框架，证明混合结构期望遗憾严格低于任一骨干且存在唯一最优触发步。
evidence.quote: we first develop a unified error-scaling theoretical framework and prove that, under explicit error-scaling assumptions, i) the hybrid structure achieves strictly lower expected regret than either backbone alone, and ii) there exists a unique optimal trigger step that minimizes the hybrid regret.

evidence.quote: We then design a lightweight adaptive trigger that combines policy entropy and RL-DM disagreement to detect trajectory-level signals of the regime shift as a practical proxy, since the optimal trigger step is defined at the expected-regret level and is not directly computable on individual trajectories.

evidence.claim: 实验表明HyCO在多样基准上相较两种骨干取得一致性改进并支持自适应触发的有效性。
evidence.quote: Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that HyCO achieves consistent improvements over both backbones and support the empirical effectiveness of adaptive triggering.

experiments: 在多样基准上实验，结果表明HyCO相较两种骨干求解器取得一致性改进

analysis.insight: 混合结构之所以有效，是因为它让RL求解器只负责其遗憾增长缓慢的早期构造阶段，而在复合误差尚未主导之前把剩余决策交给不随horizon复合的扩散模型，从而在总体上取得比任一单一骨干更低的期望遗憾。该洞察的关键不在于简单拼接两个模块，而在于存在一个唯一的最优触发步使混合遗憾最小化，而该触发步只在期望遗憾层面定义、无法在单条轨迹上直接计算，因此需要设计可观测的轨迹级代理信号来近似触发时机。

paper.abstract: Sequential reinforcement learning (RL) solvers and global diffusion model (DM) solvers for neural combinatorial optimization exhibit complementary failure modes under an optimization-regret view. The former enjoys small marginal regret in the early construction stage, but suffers from horizon-wise compounding errors with super-linear regret growth; the latter avoids horizon compounding but incurs linear or sublinear regret w.r.t. the dimension of the remaining unsolved subspace. We propose Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization (HyCO), a hybrid inference algorithm that constructs a solution prefix with an RL solver and adaptively switches to a conditional DM to complete the remaining decisions. To characterize why such hybridization helps, when to trigger the handover, and how to realize it in practice, we first develop a unified error-scaling theoretical framework and prove that, under explicit error-scaling assumptions, i) the hybrid structure achieves strictly lower expected regret than either backbone alone, and ii) there exists a unique optimal trigger step that minimizes the hybrid regret. We then design a lightweight adaptive trigger that combines policy entropy and RL-DM disagreement to detect trajectory-level signals of the regime shift as a practical proxy, since the optimal trigger step is defined at the expected-regret level and is not directly computable on individual trajectories. Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that HyCO achieves consistent improvements over both backbones and support the empirical effectiveness of adaptive triggering.
paper.title: HyCO: A Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization

paper.abstract: The fixed-charge network flow problem (FCNFP) couples continuous flow allocation with discrete arc-activation decisions, making it a canonical but computationally challenging model for a variety of network design and resource allocation problems. Exact mixed-integer linear programming formulations capture the fixed-charge structure faithfully, but often become difficult to solve on large networks. We propose a scalable continuous-optimization algorithm for large-scale single-commodity FCNFP based on an iteratively reweighted least-squares (IRLS) framework. The method replaces the discontinuous fixed-charge and linear arc cost objective with a smooth nonconvex Lasry--Lions surrogate and solves a sequence of weighted quadratic flow subproblems. Each subproblem is solved by a warm-started dual semismooth Newton method whose Newton systems have weighted graph-Laplacian structure, enabling the use of modern Laplacian solvers. To further improve the discovered arc supports of the challenging underlying combinatorial problem, we also develop an algorithmic variant that incorporates objective-driven perturbation restarts and an anchor-union restricted search that jointly leverages supports discovered by IRLS and by complementary FCNFP heuristics. Computational experiments on 410 benchmark, synthetic, and large-scale instances show that our method obtains the best objective quality among the evaluated scalable FCNFP algorithms, with a mean gap of $1.316\%$ to a time-limited MILP reference and a win-or-tie rate of $90.0\%$ among the non-MILP methods. The results indicate that combining smooth continuous optimization with support-level search is an effective strategy for producing high-quality feasible solutions to large-scale FCNFP.
paper.title: Support Discovery With Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares for Fixed-Charge Network Flow

paper.abstract: Discrete black-box optimization is often addressed using approaches such as Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO), which aims to improve sample efficiency by fitting surrogate models that approximate a costly objective function over a discrete search space. In many real-world problems, the set of feasible inputs is often given by logical constraints known in advance. However, existing surrogate modeling techniques generally fail to capture the symbolic rules governing feasibility in discrete input spaces. In this paper, we propose a surrogate modeling approach based on tensor decomposition that captures the structure of discrete search spaces while directly integrating feasibility information. To implement this approach, we formulate surrogate model training as a constrained polynomial optimization problem and solve a relaxed formulation using a differentiable penalty term derived from T-norms. Our experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks, including a pressure vessel design task, demonstrate that the proposed method improves sample efficiency by effectively guiding the search away from infeasible regions.

paper.abstract: Can an agent learn a numerical search strategy through executable practice and then transfer that strategy as text? We study low-budget black-box optimization, where unaided language models remain well below strong classical optimizers. During development, an agent repeatedly writes and evaluates optimizer programs. It then distills the resulting program and practice record once into a 197-word primary Harness A, which is frozen before evaluation. Harness A reduces Gemini Flash regret by 48\% in an independent $N=30$ study ($p<.001$), enters the GP-BO performance range on the practice family, and lowers mean regret on all three held-out BBOB landscapes. The same text improves every tested Gemini executor and transfers to Claude Sonnet, reducing regret by 43\% and 49\% ($p\leq.005$). An independent end-to-end replication produces Harness B, a different program and text at the same performance tier. The same framework also attains the lowest regret on a sealed YouTube reward-tuning production benchmark. Executable practice is thus a viable way to discover a search policy, and language a portable medium for deploying it.
paper.title: Building the Harness Automatically: Self-Play in Code Distills a Text Harness for Black-Box Optimization

analysis.analysis: 作者首先证明该重排序问题为 NP-complete，从而确立需要精确算法而非仅启发式。随后利用问题的时间与序列结构，将其分解为两阶段：第一阶段用分支定价求解主问题，并针对三种不同主问题版本定义各自的子问题图；第二阶段接收分支产生的部分整数解，用约束规划模型尝试构造原问题的可行解，若不可行则向主问题添加可行性割（feasibility cut），形成 BP-CP 精确框架。材料未说明是否使用下界推导或图表示之外的其他结构分析。
challenges: 问题被证明为 NP-complete，精确求解随生产批量增大而困难
主问题与子问题需在不同图结构上定义，且三种主问题版本各有子问题结构
部分整数解到可行解的恢复需要约束规划模型和第二类割的配合
返回车道的加入增加了状态空间和重排序复杂度
缓冲区车道容量与完工时间之间存在非单调关系，容量扩展未必提升效率

evidence.claim: 研究问题为通过缓冲区重新排列汽车顺序以最小化重排序完工时间
evidence.quote: The car resequencing problem involves rearranging the sequence of cars between two adjacent production shops via an intermediate buffer. This study explores a new variant that aims to minimize the resequencing makespan when the buffer features several forward lanes and a return lane (RL).

evidence.claim: 问题被证明为 NP-complete，并采用两阶段分支定价与约束规划结合的精确方法
evidence.quote: We prove the problem is NP-complete and develop an exact two-stage branch-and-price approach integrated with constraint programming (BP-CP).

evidence.claim: 第二阶段用约束规划从部分整数解得到可行解或可行性割
evidence.quote: Using partial integer solutions from branching, a constraint-programming model built in the second stage yields either a feasible solution to the problem or a feasibility cut added to the MP.

evidence.claim: 返回车道显著增强重排序灵活性，使较小缓冲区达到与无 RL 较大缓冲区相当的完工时间
evidence.quote: A comparative analysis shows that the RL markedly enhances resequencing flexibility, enabling smaller buffers to attain makespans comparable to those of larger buffers without the RL across varying resequencing complexities.

evidence.claim: 仅扩展车道容量提升有限甚至可能降低效率，返回车道支持更小更经济的缓冲区设计
evidence.quote: Expanding lane capacity alone yields limited gains in resequencing performance and may even reduce efficiency. The RL acts as several forward lanes, supporting a smaller and cost-effective buffer design while maintaining efficient just-in-time operations.

experiments: 实验结果表明 BP-CP 大幅提升了单个生产批次的可求解实例规模，尤其是使用适度松弛的主问题时
对比分析表明返回车道显著增强了重排序灵活性，使得较小缓冲区在不同重排序复杂度下能够达到与无返回车道的较大缓冲区相当的完工时间
管理启示表明仅扩展车道容量对重排序性能提升有限，甚至可能降低效率；返回车道可相当于多条正向车道，支持更小且经济的缓冲区设计
摘要未提供具体基线、实例规模数值、运行时间、训练开销、公平计算预算、泛化或消融结果，材料未说明这些细节
analysis.insight: 返回车道通过允许汽车在正向车道之间循环移动，实质上为缓冲区提供了额外的重排序自由度，使得较小缓冲区也能达到与无 RL 的较大缓冲区相当的完工时间。这一结构效应比单纯增加正向车道容量更有效，因为额外车道只增加存储而 RL 增加的是序列调整的操作空间。算法上，将问题分解为主问题与子问题，并在第二阶段用约束规划从分支得到的部分整数解中恢复可行解或生成可行性割，能够有效提升精确方法可求解的实例规模。
limitations: 材料未说明作者明确陈述的局限
method: 证明该重排序问题为 NP-complete
提出两阶段精确分支定价与约束规划相结合的方法（BP-CP）
第一阶段提出三种主问题（MP）版本，每个版本配对定义在特定图上的子问题
第二阶段基于分支得到的部分整数解构建约束规划模型，产出可行解或可行性割反馈给主问题

对比分析返回车道与无返回车道缓冲区在不同重排序复杂度下的完工时间表现
analysis.motivation: 汽车制造中相邻车间之间存在序列不一致，需要借助缓冲区进行重排序以维持后一车间的目标序列。传统缓冲区若仅增加正向车道容量，可能带来成本上升而性能提升有限。作者关注引入返回车道这一新结构变体，以期在更小、更经济的缓冲区下仍能高效完成重排序，并研究其精确求解方法与可解规模。
analysis.primary_topic: 汽车重排序问题的精确求解与缓冲区结构设计
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文直接研究生产系统中的序列调整与排序优化，属于生产调度与运筹优化范畴，其目标函数（完工时间最小化）和 NP 完全性分析对车间调度研究有参考价值。方法上采用分支定价与约束规划结合，属于数学规划与约束推理的混合精确方法，而非神经网络、强化学习或大模型智能体方法。与当前研究画像中关注的柔性作业车间、流水车间、生产运输协同、动态扰动、能效和多目标优化存在主题邻近，但本文未涉及上述扩展。若迁移到车间调度或其他序列优化问题，推测需要满足：问题可分解为主问题与定价子问题、子问题可在图上定义、且允许用约束规划修复部分解；迁移设想的成立还需要验证缓冲区或中间存储结构是否与目标调度问题兼容，这些均为推测，非作者结论。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为汽车重排序问题：在两个相邻生产车间之间通过中间缓冲区重新排列汽车顺序，目标是最小化重排序完工时间（makespan），即在最短时间内将初始序列转换为目标序列。关键约束与信息假设包括：缓冲区由若干条正向车道（forward lanes）和一条返回车道（return lane, RL）组成，两类车道均遵循先进先出（FIFO）规则但运行方向相反；通过 RL，汽车可以在正向车道之间循环，从而增加重排序的灵活性与复杂度。材料未说明车间内部生产逻辑、到达时间分布、是否动态扰动、车辆属性分类等细节，也未说明随机或确定性环境，仅从“position cars over time”可推断为确定性时序排程问题。
analysis.title_zh: 带完工时间最小化的汽车重排序问题
analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据标题与摘要判断，未提供全文，因此无法确认实验的具体基线、实例规模、算法参数、主问题三种版本的具体差异、约束规划模型的细节、以及作者是否讨论局限。相关性分数给 6 是因为该文属于生产调度与运筹优化相邻方向，且具有明确的迁移路径，但未涉及智能优化、神经网络辅助求解、强化学习或智能体优化等方法。
analysis.why_recommended: 对于研究生产调度与运筹优化的博士生，本文提供了一个精确求解序列重排序问题的范例：如何证明 NP 完全性、设计两阶段分支定价与约束规划混合框架、利用部分整数解生成可行性割，以及如何分析缓冲区结构对调度性能的非单调影响。尽管不涉及学习型方法，但其问题建模、分解策略和结构分析对约束可行性、求解质量与缓冲区设计问题具有迁移参考价值。

paper.abstract: Problem definition: The car resequencing problem involves rearranging the sequence of cars between two adjacent production shops via an intermediate buffer. This study explores a new variant that aims to minimize the resequencing makespan when the buffer features several forward lanes and a return lane (RL). Both types of lanes follow first-in-first-out rules, but operate in opposite directions. Through the RL, cars can circulate between forward lanes, thereby increasing resequencing flexibility and complexity. The goal is to position cars over time to complete the target sequence change in the shortest possible time. Methodology/results: We prove the problem is NP-complete and develop an exact two-stage branch-and-price approach integrated with constraint programming (BP-CP). Three versions of the master problem (MP) are proposed for the first stage, each paired with a subproblem defined on a specific graph. Using partial integer solutions from branching, a constraint-programming model built in the second stage yields either a feasible solution to the problem or a feasibility cut added to the MP. Experimental results indicate that BP-CP greatly increases the scale of solvable instances for a production batch, especially with a moderately relaxed MP. A comparative analysis shows that the RL markedly enhances resequencing flexibility, enabling smaller buffers to attain makespans comparable to those of larger buffers without the RL across varying resequencing complexities. Managerial implications: Expanding lane capacity alone yields limited gains in resequencing performance and may even reduce efficiency. The RL acts as several forward lanes, supporting a smaller and cost-effective buffer design while maintaining efficient just-in-time operations.
paper.title: The Car Resequencing Problem with Makespan Minimization

analysis.analysis: 作者通过类比机组组合中的机组启动过程，识别出模型副本加载是一种具有跨时段耦合的承诺行为，因此将问题构造为联合调度模型部署与跨站点请求路由的混合整数线性规划；并利用LLM推理两阶段特性，将TTFT约束写成请求量不超过由该阶段时延参数、模型吞吐与副本就绪状态共同决定的容量上界（式11），将TPOT约束按剖面实验观察到的SLO合规比例与TPOT上限近似成正比的关系，表示为与实验标定系数相关的容量上界（式12），从而把延迟要求显式嵌入线性约束。
challenges: 模型副本加载与预热需要显著时间，导致请求路由与部署决策之间存在跨时段耦合，不能按单时段独立决策
LLM推理的prefill(TTFT)与decode(TPOT)延迟约束需转换为每副本每时段的容量上界，且需与功率约束、电价信号共同纳入统一优化
若忽略加载时间或延迟约束，会导致物理上不可执行的转移与大量未服务需求，需要在模型中同时保证可行性并兼顾成本

evidence.claim: 论文指出已有负载转移方法假设有足够算力的数据中心可立即服务转移请求，忽略模型副本必须已加载这一点，可能导致不可行转移与未服务需求
evidence.quote: However, existing workload-shifting methods typically assume that any data center with sufficient computing resources can immediately serve shifted requests, which may lead to infeasible transfers and unserved demand.

evidence.claim: 论文提出模型承诺（MC），一个在功率约束与电价信号下联合调度模型部署与跨站点请求路由的混合整数线性规划框架
evidence.quote: this letter proposes model commitment (MC), a mixed-integer linear programming framework that jointly schedules model deployment and cross-site request routing under power constraints and electricity-price signals.

evidence.claim: MC将模型副本加载引起的跨时段耦合形式化，并把prefill与decode延迟要求转换为每个副本可服务需求量的约束
evidence.quote: First, MC formulates the intertemporal coupling introduced by model replica loading. Second, it translates prefill and decode latency requirements into the amount of demand that each replica can serve.

evidence.claim: 案例研究显示MC在时变电网条件下达到100%服务率并将总运行成本降低29.0%
evidence.quote: Case studies based on real-world data show that MC enables AI data center operators to achieve a 100% service rate under time-varying grid conditions and reduce total operating cost by 29.0%.

evidence.claim: 作者把模型副本加载类比为机组组合中的机组启动，需要提前决策部署
evidence.quote: Similar to generator start-up in unit commitment (UC), loading and warming up these replicas require substantial time.

evidence.claim: 论文给出TTFT约束的形式化表达，将请求量限制为就绪副本可服务容量
evidence.quote: the final TTFT constraint can be imposed in MC as

evidence.claim: 论文给出TPOT约束形式化，依据剖面实验中SLO合规比例与TPOT上限近似成正比的关系
evidence.quote: Profiling experiments show that the SLO-compliant fraction is approximately proportional to the TPOT limit within the practical operating range

evidence.claim: 消融基线显示忽略加载时间(B3)、TTFT(B5)或TPOT(B6)约束会使服务率显著下降

experiments: 基于真实数据的案例研究，包含三个数据中心，使用美国三个地区的真实节点电价曲线作为电网信号
LLM请求到达基于真实OpenAI工作负载轨迹，选取Qwen2.5-32B、Llama-3.3-70B与DeepSeek-V3作为代表性负载
PUE、模型服务吞吐与GPU规格等参数依据已发表测量或实验结果标定，完整参数设置见参考文献[9]
对比基线包括B1-Myopic（30分钟前瞻、无全时段信息）、B2-Static（固定副本部署）、B3-ZeroLeadTime（忽略加载时间）、B4-NoPriceSignal（忽略节点价差）、B5-NoTTFT（省略TTFT约束）、B6-NoTPOT（省略TPOT约束），其中B3、B5、B6在全约束下物理重演

paper.abstract: AI data centers may face power supply shortages during certain periods, requiring operators to shift large language model (LLM) inference workloads spatially to maintain service rates. However, existing workload-shifting methods typically assume that any data center with sufficient computing resources can immediately serve shifted requests, which may lead to infeasible transfers and unserved demand. This letter proposes model commitment (MC), a mixed-integer linear programming framework that jointly schedules model deployment and cross-site request routing under power constraints and electricity-price signals. First, MC formulates the intertemporal coupling introduced by model replica loading. Second, it translates prefill and decode latency requirements into the amount of demand that each replica can serve. Case studies based on real-world data show that MC enables AI data center operators to achieve a 100% service rate under time-varying grid conditions and reduce total operating cost by 29.0%.
paper.title: Spatial LLM Workload Shifting Needs Foresight: Model Commitment for AI Data Center Operation under Power Grid Constraints

figures.caption: Overview of SOLID . The policy first generates on-policy trajectories whose programs are evaluated and grouped by solver feedback, yielding group-relative rewards and a majority-group solver artifact. The same policy then uses this artifact as privileged context, while an LP-structured mask restricts self-distillation to structurally mismatched variable, constraint, objective, and code sections. The masked token-level signal and sequence-level reward jointly update the deployable policy.

paper.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language descriptions into operations research (OR) formulations. Post-training techniques including reinforcement learning and on-policy self-distillation have further improved this capability. However, three limitations remain in training LLMs for OR formulations. First, training commonly relies on synthetic formulations validated by human experts or stronger models, constraining scalable supervision. Second, credit assignment is either coarse or costly: outcome rewards score an entire trajectory without locating the responsible modeling decision, whereas process-level supervision requires an additional evaluator. Third, privileged self-distillation can induce style mismatch by using solver context unavailable at deployment. We find that a model can improve from solver-artifact feedback generated by its own rollouts, making self-distillation a practical, evaluator-free source of dense supervision. Therefore, we propose SOLID: Solver-Informed On-Policy LearnIng through Self-Distillation, a novel framework for self-improving OR language models without verified answers or external evaluators. SOLID executes candidate programs from multiple rollouts, clusters their objectives, and selects a majority-group artifact as a pseudo-reference. The model then performs updates using group-relative advantages and dense self-supervision signals. Across multiple OR benchmarks, SOLID improves solution accuracy for both general-purpose and OR-tuned models over outcome-only group-relative training. These results show that solver artifacts can support scalable self-improvement without trusted answers.
paper.title: Beyond Verified Answers: Solver-Informed Self-Distillation for Bootstrapping Operations Research Language Models

paper.abstract: Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) is a central formulation for combinatorial optimization and has gained increasing attention due to its compatibility with quantum, hybrid quantum-classical, and quantum-inspired solvers. However, translating natural-language problem descriptions into correct QUBO formulations remains difficult, requiring the identification of binary variables, constraints, objective functions, penalty terms, and suitable penalty weights. This process is time-consuming and often demands substantial domain expertise. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end multi-agent framework that automatically generates QUBO formulations from natural-language problem descriptions, supported by structured or unstructured test cases. To evaluate its performance, We also introduce QUBOBench, a benchmark containing 100 combinatorial optimization problems across 12 application domains, curated from peer-reviewed literature, competitions, and canonical NP-hard problems. Experimental results show that our framework achieves 68% accuracy on QUBOBench, outperforming a direct single-call baseline by 22%. Further analysis identifies iterative self-repair as the most important component contributing to improved performance. The data and code are open-sourced at https://quitttcat.github.io/QuantumQUBOAgent.

paper.abstract: Efficient routing optimization is essential to freight transportation, urban logistics, and shared mobility, where high-quality heuristics are often required under limited computational budgets. Recent large language model (LLM)-based automated heuristic design methods can generate effective routing rules, but aggregate evaluation may mask recurrent failures on particular instance structures. To address this limitation, this study develops RouteRepair, which diagnoses parent-specific weaknesses from instance-level performance and applies targeted modifications to the corresponding heuristic components while protecting behavior that already performs well. Routing evidence, solver behavior, and program context are combined to define bounded repair objectives, and each intervention is validated through matched parent-child evaluation of failure recovery and collateral degradation. Experiments on the traveling salesman problem (TSP) and capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) span constructive search, guided local search, and ant colony optimization. RouteRepair-GLS reduces the mean TSP optimality gap from 1.7476% to 0.7587%, while the constructive CVRP heuristic lowers average route cost by 1.91% relative to the savings heuristic; the generated ACO priors also outperform matched hand-designed priors. These results show that failure-aware, evidence-constrained refinement can improve routing heuristics on difficult instances while preserving performance on cases they already solve well.
paper.title: RouteRepair: Instance-Level Failure Diagnosis and Targeted Repair in LLM-Based Automated Heuristic Design for Routing Optimization

paper.abstract: Energy-aware scheduling has become a central challenge in modern manufacturing environments. As industries increasingly aim to reduce operational costs and carbon emissions, aligning production activities with electricity tariffs is increasingly important. The integration of battery energy storage system (BESS) further enhances the potential to reduce energy purchase costs; however, incorporating such systems introduces complex interdependencies between job scheduling and BESS management decisions, significantly complicating the problem structure.\\In this work, we study the problem of minimizing the energy cost of executing a set of jobs on a single machine within a fixed time horizon, where electricity prices follow a Time-of-Use (TOU) tariff. In addition, we consider the presence of a BESS that can be charged from the grid and discharged during high-price periods to reduce overall energy costs. To efficiently address this problem, we propose and analyze two matheuristic algorithm variants designed to effectively coordinate production scheduling and BESS usage decisions.
paper.title: Efficient Algorithms for Energy-Aware Single-Machine Scheduling with Battery Storage

analysis.analysis: 论文将动态优化形式化为在累积自然语言修改下的优化问题：每一轮从请求与输入表出发，后续修改定义时刻t的可行集与目标向量；单目标要求输出一个可行且目标值小的方案，多目标要求输出互不支配的可行方案集。作者通过维护可执行状态、事件记录与候选解进行分解式处理，并将语言式问题构建与数学规划、进化搜索结合，用固定求解器执行并由隐藏评测器离线评分比较。

paper.abstract: Domain practitioners understand their business constraints but may lack operations-research expertise or dedicated support. LLM-based optimization agents translate natural-language requirements into models or solver programs that established optimization tools can execute. This progress makes optimization more accessible, but real-world operations are dynamic: changing demand, resources, and priorities require updates to data, constraints, and objectives. Methods centered on isolated requests offer limited support for rapid adaptation that preserves earlier decisions and reuses useful search results. We introduce MAPLE (Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution), an agent for maintaining optimization problems through successive natural-language requests. MAPLE combines language-based problem construction with mathematical programming and evolutionary search. It retains the optimization program, accepted plans, earlier updates, and candidate solutions for subsequent requests. We introduce NLDO, a benchmark of 15 trajectories and 180 updates spanning selection, scheduling, rostering, routing, and cloud-resource placement. In the main evaluation, MAPLE completes all trajectories and achieves online scalar quality of 0.951 and a Pareto hypervolume ratio of 0.875. Controlled comparisons further show that maintaining executable state improves update validity and can preserve useful search information across substantial revisions.
paper.title: MAPLE: Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution

analysis.analysis: 作者将 FMP 建模为多目标混合整数问题，目标为最大化长期机队可用性，并显式刻画飞机使用与维修之间的紧密耦合；把循环检查需求与维修坞容量作为硬约束纳入模型。针对计算复杂度，作者利用问题的时间结构采用滚动时域分解，仅优化长度为 L 的预测窗并以当前解作为下一段初始化；针对多目标权重，作者把权重调节视为嵌套优化外层，用贝叶斯优化构建目标函数 J_tune(W) 的概率代理模型并迭代选择新候选权重；针对不均衡初始状态，作者依据各机与其中队目标 sc/aling 的距离以及距下次维修的距离等统计量，将权重 w1、w2、w3 改为飞机特定形式。
challenges: 混合整数多目标 FMP 问题复杂度超出所用硬件一次性求解 5 年规划的能力
多个相互竞争目标（可用性、使用与维修耦合）导致代价函数系数难以人工设定
非名义/临界初始机队状态下，新飞机被统一处理会同时趋近大检查，形成长期检查排队
循环检查要求与有限维修坞容量（仅部分维修坞可做大检查）带来的产能与可行性约束
需要保证年度计划之间平滑过渡而非短视逐年规划

experiments: 在三个真实基准场景（标准机队、临界机队、新机队）上评估所提 FMP 方案，规划期为 5 年
基准机队均由 N=25 架飞机组成，分为 F=2 个中队（20 架与 5 架），在 C=5 个维修坞中维护，其中 Γ=2 个可执行大检查
因 5 年一次性求解超出所用硬件能力，实验采用两种简化求解方式：逐年的 year-by-year（以上一年 FMP 结果作为下一年初始化）与固定 L=24 的滚动时域
结果（结论部分陈述）表明滚动时域相对短视的逐年规划有明确优势，并确认方法的计算可行性；自动调参在临界初始缩放机队上优于人工选择；飞机特定加权在刚接收新机批次的基准机队上缓解了检查排队并改善机队效率
摘要/节选未给出具体数值化的解质量、运行时间、训练开销或公平计算预算等量化指标，材料未说明

analysis.insight: 核心洞察在于：多年 FMP 的困难既来自混合整数多目标模型的求解复杂度，也来自多目标权重难以人工设定以及初始机队状态不均衡。作者通过滚动时域把长周期问题分解为可计算的短预测窗（L=24，即两年预测期）以降低计算负担并保证年度计划间平滑过渡；通过贝叶斯优化在嵌套问题外层自动调节代价函数系数，减少人工调参并缓解不利初始状态；再依据机队状态统计为每架飞机定制权重，使剩余飞行小时在飞机间更均匀分布，从而避免新机同时趋近大检查造成长期排队。其有效性来自将“可计算性—权重选择—个体差异”三个实际障碍分别用分解、自动调参和自适应加权来处理，而非单纯依赖模型规模。
limitations: 当前方案假设循环检查框架，可能无法反映所有军用机队运行方式
未来工作拟扩展到非循环与依赖日历的检查，以及实际中常见的维修提前与延迟
另一方向是增强对可能扰乱飞行与维修计划的突发与随机事件的鲁棒性

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文属于运筹优化中的混合整数计划与调度问题，与智能优化、生产调度在“多目标约束下的长周期计划—维修/产能耦合—分解求解”层面具有明确迁移价值：其滚动时域分解、贝叶斯优化自动调参、按个体状态自适应加权的三层机制，可直接类比到柔性作业车间/流水车间的长周期调度、分布式制造与生产运输协同中的多目标权重设定及个体差异处理。需要说明的是，论文本身未使用神经网络、图神经网络、强化学习或多智能体方法，其学习成分仅为替代模型驱动的贝叶斯优化；因此将其中机制迁移到学习辅助搜索或强化学习调度属于推测，需满足的条件包括：把滚动时域窗口与学习型调度器耦合、把权重自动调参推广为奖励/代价塑形、并验证在随机扰动与动态事件下的可行性与公平计算预算下的泛化性。
analysis.setting: 论文研究防务部门的飞行与维修计划（Flight and Maintenance Planning, FMP）问题：决策对象为一支由 N=25 架飞机组成、分为 F=2 个中队（分别 20 架与 5 架）的机队，规划期为 5 年，目标是在满足循环检查要求与有限维修坞容量（C=5 个维修坞，其中 Γ=2 个可执行大检查）的前提下最大化机队长期可用性；约束包括使用与维修的紧密耦合、循环检查需求、维修坞产能上限以及各机型的剩余飞行小时（RFH）与剩余维修时间（RMT）等；信息假设为初始机队状态可能非理想（非名义状态），摘要与全文节选未说明是否考虑随机扰动或不确定性，动态扰动要素材料未说明。

paper.abstract: While existing strategies for Flight and Maintenance Planning for the defense sector generally address idealized conditions, real-world planning often involve non-nominal initial fleet states and complex inspection schemes. To address these challenges, we propose a multi-year planning strategy that maximizes long-term fleet availability. The formulation incorporates multiple competing objectives capturing the tight coupling between aircraft usage and maintenance, while enforcing cyclic inspection requirements and limited maintenance-dock capacity. To enhance practical applicability, we introduce three complementary strategies: a receding-horizon approach to reduce computational burden, a Bayesian Optimization routine to automatically tune cost-function coefficients, and an aircraft-specific weighting scheme that adapts model priorities based on fleet-condition statistics. Results on three realistic benchmark scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.
paper.title: Mixed-integer optimization for multi-year military aircraft fleet management

analysis.analysis: 材料未说明作者如何具体分析问题；摘要层面显示作者以“翻译鸿沟”为切入点，把问题结构拆分为语义翻译层（大模型）与形式化求解层（精确组合方法），并通过数字孪生的双向耦合机制把运营观测状态与优化决策状态联系起来，同时用系统松弛量作为修复与重优化之间切换的判断依据。
challenges: 非结构化运营日志与定性人类输入到形式化数学约束之间的语义翻译鸿沟
在引入大语言模型的同时保持精确组合优化方法的可行性保证
定性扰动事件需要在运行时动态改变优化问题可行域，而不是离线重新建模
运营观测与优化决策之间的双向同步，即数字孪生的状态一致性要求

analysis.insight: 贡献有效的关键不在于把大模型当作求解器，而在于对其角色进行结构性重定位：大模型只负责把非结构化运营话语与定性扰动事件翻译为形式化数学约束，求解仍交由具有可行性保证的精确组合方法完成。由此，语言模型的能力被限制在它擅长的语义层，而可行域的修改权仍由数学优化掌握；再配合基于可用系统松弛量的自适应决策策略，系统能在便宜但局部的调度修复与昂贵但全局的重优化之间按需切换，使静态模型获得对运营不确定性的弹性。
limitations: 材料未说明
method: 神经符号框架架构：将大语言模型定位为语义翻译器而非直接求解器，由精确组合方法承担求解并保留可行性保证
动态约束注入机制：在运行时把定性的扰动事件翻译为形式化的数学约束，从而结构性修改优化问题的可行域
双向耦合与知识图谱：运营观测更新虚拟模型状态，优化后的决策再反射回知识图谱，以满足数字孪生的同步要求

analysis.motivation: 实际运营中的扰动与人类判断通常以日志、口语化描述等非结构化形式出现，难以直接进入数学模型；若让大模型直接求解组合优化问题，则可能丧失可行性保证。作者希望保留精确组合方法的严格性，同时让大模型只承担“语义翻译”的角色，把运营话语转成形式化约束，从而在不牺牲可行性的前提下让优化模型实时响应运营现实。
analysis.primary_topic: 神经符号中间件：用大模型把非结构化运营日志与定性扰动翻译为数学优化约束，并耦合数字孪生状态
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文与智能优化和 AI4OR 直接相关：它研究如何用大语言模型作为语义接口去修改数学优化模型的可行域，并保留精确组合方法的可行性保证，这与生产调度中“动态扰动—重调度—修复与重优化权衡”的问题结构高度一致。其自适应策略以系统松弛量为判断依据，在概念上可对应柔性作业车间、流水车间或分布式制造中的产能松弛与交期松弛。需要说明的是，论文本身并未涉及生产调度、作业车间或流水车间，因此“把动态约束注入与松弛量驱动的修复/重优化切换迁移到调度场景”属于推测；该迁移成立的条件是：调度领域的定性扰动（如设备异常、人员口头反馈、工艺变更）能够被稳定地形式化为调度约束，且存在可量化、可比较的系统松弛度量作为修复与重优化的切换判据。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是在数学优化与真实运营环境之间存在的“翻译鸿沟”：运营侧产生的是非结构化的运营日志与定性的人类输入，而优化侧需要严格的形式化数学模型。决策对象是优化问题的可行域结构以及在扰动下的调度决策；目标是让精确组合优化方法在动态不确定环境中仍保持可行性保证，同时把定性扰动事件实时转化为形式化约束，并在数字孪生中实现运营观测与优化决策的双向同步。关键约束包括必须保留精确组合方法的可行性保证、扰动事件以定性形式出现而非数值形式、以及系统需要在低复杂度调度修复与完整重优化之间做自适应选择。信息假设是运营日志为无结构文本、人类输入为定性描述，而系统内部维护一个虚拟模型状态与知识图谱。静态或动态环境方面：论文明确将静态模型转变为能适应真实环境运营不确定性与变异性的弹性系统，因此面向的是动态环境；其余要素材料未说明。

analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据标题与摘要判断，未提供全文，因此无法核实具体的技术实现、六个优化领域的身份、基线设置、实验规模、解质量与运行时间，也无法判断可行性保证在引入大模型翻译后是如何被形式化论证或测试的；此外无法确认第一单位与通讯作者信息；相关性评分基于方法机制的潜在可迁移性，而非论文实际研究生产调度问题。
analysis.why_recommended: 对关注学习与搜索/精确求解结合的研究者而言，这篇工作提供了一个明确的分工范式：大模型不做求解，而做约束语义翻译，求解可行性与最优性交给组合优化，这正好回应了 AI4OR 中“学习如何介入而不破坏可行性”的核心关切。此外，动态约束注入与基于松弛量的自适应修复/重优化切换，对动态扰动下的生产调度、生产运输协同与多目标约束优化具有可借鉴的机制价值，且作者声称跨六个优化领域验证了泛化性，值得进一步核查其设置与公平计算预算。

paper.abstract: We introduce GenOR-Twin, a neuro-symbolic framework that bridges the translation gap between unstructured operational logs and rigorous mathematical optimization. Our architecture uniquely positions Large Language Models as semantic translators rather than direct solvers, ensuring that the system retains the feasibility guarantees of exact combinatorial methods. { \color{red}We design a dynamic constraint injection mechanism (the runtime translation of qualitative disruption events into formal mathematical constraints) that allows the system to structurally modify the optimization problem's feasibility region in real-time based on qualitative human inputs. The resulting bidirectional coupling---where operational observations update the virtual model state and optimized decisions are reflected back into the Knowledge Graph---satisfies the synchronization requirement of a proper Digital Twin. The framework features an adaptive decision policy} that automatically selects between low-complexity schedule repair and full re-optimization by analyzing the available system slack. Finally, we demonstrate the generalization of this approach across six distinct optimization domains, {\color{red}turning static models into resilient systems that adapt to the operational uncertainty and variability of real-world environments.}
paper.title: GenOR-Twin: A Semantic Middleware for Integrating Operational Discourse with Mathematical Optimization

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文直接研究算法选择中的评估保真度问题，其核心机制——分区级 oracle 分数与可部署学习选择器之间的差距——可迁移到生产调度与智能优化中的求解器/算法选择场景。论文事实层面，作者在五个公开算法选择基准上验证了正 G(R) 与符号翻转现象；迁移设想层面（推测），若将分解式算法选择框架用于柔性作业车间或流水车间的求解器选择，需要满足以下条件：分区级评估可用、族内选择器可学习、且能获得端到端部署效用的评估预算。该工作对关注学习辅助搜索与算法选择的调度研究者具有方法学参考价值，但论文本身未涉及生产调度实例。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为分解式算法选择流水线中分区级（partition-level）评估与可部署端到端系统实际效用之间的偏差；决策对象是在固定家族选择器之后，如何在选定算法族内部用学习到的族内选择器替代族内 oracle；目标为量化并修正分区级报告与部署端到端效用之间的差距；关键约束是分区级分数只给出族内最优的 oracle 选择，而可部署系统必须用学习到的选择器替代该 oracle；信息假设为分区级评估可获得族内 oracle 信息，而部署时只能基于学习信号；静态或动态环境材料未说明。

paper.abstract: Oracle-style quantities, including virtual best solvers, selected-portfolio VBS, virtual-best encodings, and best-in-family summaries, are widely reported as upper bounds on what a deployable selector could achieve. In decomposed algorithm selection, an analogous partition-level score grants an oracle choice of the best algorithm within the selected family; once the family selector is fixed, the deployable system must replace that within-family oracle with a learned within-family selector. We define the deployment-fidelity gap G(R) as the difference between partition-level and deployable end-to-end utility and derive two accounting consequences: a per-instance margin-regret stability condition that tells us when a partition-time family choice is deployment-optimal, and a sharp partition-only identification interval that, when it strictly crosses zero, prevents the partition-level report from certifying the deployable winner. Across five public algorithm-selection benchmarks spanning tabular AutoML and combinatorial CSP/SAT, every decomposed pipeline has positive G(R), ranging from 0.012 on TabZilla to 0.13 on PROTEUS-2014. Four of ten decomposed-versus-flat decisions have sign-changing point estimates; on PROTEUS-2014, a 33-point partition advantage shrinks to a 20-point end-to-end advantage. A training-side validation gap-correction diagnostic recovers the point-estimate deployable sign on all four sign-changing cells; it is a reporting aid, not a substitute for direct end-to-end evaluation. Partition and end-to-end scores should be reported side by side.
paper.title: Partition Scores Are Not System Scores: Deployment-Fidelity Gaps in Decomposed Algorithm Selection

analysis.analysis: 作者通过文献分析将 MDS 与集合覆盖的近似困难性联系起来，并梳理了经典精确算法、近似算法与启发式在不同图类上的表现。作者进一步将机器学习求解组合优化的范式划分为全局预测（GP）、局部构建（LC）和自适应扩展（AE），并把自身方法定位为 GP 类方法，理由是 MDS 上 GP 在计算效率方面尤其有吸引力。作者还分析了已有最相关工作 Kothapalli 等人的 GCN 启发式，指出其仍依赖迭代贪心，并据此提出无监督损失与集成解码的改进方向。此外，作者在讨论局限时分析了小图训练分布与大规模真实图在度分布、社区结构和长程依赖上的差异。

analysis.insight: 该工作的核心洞察在于：可以把支配集可行性与规模目标直接编码为可微的无监督损失，使节点选择概率在仅观察图结构的情况下被端到端优化。显式的大小惩罚与覆盖惩罚使模型倾向于生成小而覆盖全图的集合，而 equalizer 项让概率预测更果断，从而便于后续解码。由于该范式属于全局预测（GP），一次前向即可得到所有节点的分数，成本被摊销到训练阶段，因此推理阶段可比元启发式和监督学习基线更快。多种互补解码策略的集成进一步弥补了单次概率预测在结构多样性上的不足，从而在质量与速度之间取得新的折中位置。
limitations: 小图训练分布无法覆盖真实大图在度分布、社区结构、长程依赖等方面的特征，因此需要在包含更大且更异质图的分布上重新训练，才可能获得强的大图性能。
未来工作可考虑层次化消息传递或图粗化等架构修改来提升可扩展性。
method: 采用图神经网络作为节点打分器，对每个节点输出被选入支配集的概率，属于全局预测（GP）范式：一次前向即可得到全部节点的概率。
设计无监督概率损失，包含大小项、覆盖项和一个 equalizer 项，训练时不需要真值最优解，仅使用图结构。
使用 12,000 张具有多样结构属性的合成图进行训练。
推理阶段采用四种解码策略构成的集成，将节点概率转换为合法支配集，并利用不同算法的互补优势提升稳健性。
整体框架将学习到的启发式与解码搜索相结合：网络负责提供全局概率先验，解码策略负责保证可行性与提升解质量。
analysis.motivation: 经典 MDS 求解依赖贪心近似或组合启发式；贪心集合覆盖仅保证 O(ln Δ) 近似，且在高维、噪声大、规模巨大的现代社交网络或传感网络中可能次优且需要人工调参。已有监督式 GNN 方法需要真值解作为训练标签，获取困难。作者希望提出无监督 GNN 框架，在训练时不需要最优解标签，同时保持解质量并显著提升推理速度，并能够泛化到未见过的图分布。
analysis.primary_topic: 基于无监督图神经网络学习组合优化启发式，用于最小支配集问题及其社交网络影响力最大化应用
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实：该工作研究的是图上的 NP 难组合优化问题（最小支配集），采用无监督图神经网络学习节点选择概率，并用多策略解码集成得到可行解，强调推理速度、解质量和跨分布泛化。这与智能优化和学习辅助搜索有方法层面的关联。迁移设想（推测）：其无监督覆盖—规模损失的设计思路可推测迁移到集合覆盖类生产调度子问题、设备选择或监控点布设问题；其“网络输出全局概率 + 多解码策略集成”的框架可推测迁移到柔性作业车间或分布式制造中的机器/工序选择决策，但需要将支配语义重定义为调度可行性约束，并重新设计覆盖项、可行性校验与解码器。该工作未涉及强化学习、多智能体或大模型智能体，也未直接研究生产调度、动态扰动、能效或多目标优化，因此不能将其结论直接视为生产调度领域的证据。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为图上的最小支配集（MDS）问题：给定图 G=(V,E)，求最小的顶点子集 D⊆V，使每个顶点要么属于 D，要么与 D 中某顶点相邻。决策对象是每个顶点是否被选入支配集；目标是最小化支配集规模；约束为覆盖全部顶点。MDS 是 NP 完全问题，并且与集合覆盖的近似困难性（Feige 给出的 (1-o(1))ln n 阈值）紧密相关。应用背景包括社交网络病毒式营销、影响力最大化、公共卫生干预、信息传播等，文中也提到 Positive Influence Dominating Set 变体。信息假设：训练阶段不依赖最优解或真实标签，仅使用图结构；推理阶段使用学习到的节点概率并配合多种解码策略。静态或动态：材料中讨论的图为静态图，未说明动态扰动环境。

paper.abstract: The Minimum Dominating Set (MDS) problem is a classic NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with critical applications in social network analysis, including viral marketing, influence maximization, public health interventions, and information dissemination. Identifying a minimal set of influential individuals whose reach covers an entire social network is central to these applications, yet remains computationally challenging at scale. Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as powerful tools for learning over graphs, and recent work explores their application to hard combinatorial problems. This paper presents a novel unsupervised GNN framework for the MDS problem that eliminates the need for ground-truth solutions during training. Trained on 12,000 synthetic graphs with diverse structural properties, our method achieves up to 55x faster inference than metaheuristic baselines and up to 14x faster inference than supervised learning approaches, while finding optimal or near-optimal dominating sets on real-world social network benchmarks. Our learned heuristic generalizes effectively to unseen graph distributions, demonstrating strong practical applicability for large-scale social network analysis.
paper.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Submitted to the International Journal of Data Science and Analytics
paper.title: Graph Neural Networks for Influence Maximization in Social Networks: An Unsupervised Minimum Dominating Set Approach

analysis.analysis: 作者将问题建模为动态多模式资源受限项目调度，并针对两类决策分别设计问题特定的表型表征（PC）：活动-模式对选择与活动组选择。作者假设具有相似决策行为的 GP 个体可能具有相似适应度值，因此通过设计不同行为抽象程度的编码方案（保留原始优先值的 priority-value encoding、表示相对排序的 rank encoding、仅记录最终选择决策的 binary encoding）并结合不同距离度量来衡量 GP 个体间的行为相似性，从而构建可复用的表型表征数据库支持代理估计。作者进一步通过实验分析表型表征对表型冗余去除能力与子代多样性的影响，并通过消融实验分离去重与代理预选择的独立与联合作用。
challenges: 动态多模式项目调度中活动工期不确定、前序约束与资源约束并存，且每个活动需同时决定是否调度与执行模式

analysis.motivation: 动态项目调度中启发式规则能基于当前项目状态实时决策，但人工设计有效规则困难，因为好的调度决策往往需要在多个有时相互冲突的因素之间取得平衡。遗传规划可自动演化此类启发式规则，但其基于仿真的适应度评估计算开销巨大，因此需要在固定完整仿真评估预算下借助代理模型提高搜索效率。作者进一步指出，代理辅助 GP 的关键问题之一是 GP 个体应如何被编码为表型表征以支持有效的适应度估计。
