paper.abstract: Dynamic multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling requires decisions to be made under precedence constraints, limited resources, multiple execution modes, and uncertain activity durations. Genetic programming (GP) can automatically evolve heuristic rules for such problems, but its simulation-based fitness evaluation is computationally expensive. This study investigates phenotypic characterisation (PC) in surrogate-assisted GP to evolve higher-quality scheduling heuristics under a fixed budget of full simulation-based fitness evaluations. A key question is how GP individuals should be encoded into phenotypic characterisations to support effective fitness estimation. To answer this question, three PC encoding schemes with different levels of information richness are designed: priority-value encoding, which preserves raw rule outputs; rank encoding, which captures candidate ordering; and binary encoding, which represents final scheduling decisions. These encodings are combined with different distance metrics to measure behavioural similarity between GP individuals. The experimental results show that binary encoding with Euclidean distance provides the most effective and robust surrogate guidance. Further analyses show that surrogate estimation accuracy alone does not fully explain the performance differences. The PC representation also determines how effectively phenotypically redundant offspring are removed and how much behavioural diversity is retained after preselection. Ablation experiments further demonstrate that duplicate removal and surrogate preselection provide complementary benefits, with their combination producing the largest improvement. These findings highlight that effective surrogate-assisted GP depends not only on identifying promising offspring, but also on controlling redundancy and preserving useful diversity during evolutionary search.
paper.title: Surrogate-Assisted Genetic Programming with Phenotypic Characterisation in Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling

analysis.analysis: 作者将探索历史组织为结构化的发现树，每个节点表示一次尝试及其完整观测；历史树集合构成回放模拟器池。在离线阶段，固定历史树，对候选探索策略逐一在每棵历史树上进行回放评估：回放重置策略状态、从根出发，按策略选择批量子节点，但节点结果是预先记录的确定性返回，而非生成新候选。以此获得大量廉价、快速的离线反馈，并迭代产生多个策略版本。外层循环中，改进后的策略重新部署到在线探索，生成新的发现树并加入历史，扩大模拟器池。材料未说明作者是否使用下界、图表示或数学规划构造求解。
challenges: 固定探索策略无法随搜索空间扩展而自适应

长时程发现中训练信号稀缺且成本高
需要在不改变底层编码智能体的前提下实现可编程的探索编排
需要构建可复用的回放模拟器并保证离线评估对策略改进有效

evidence.claim: 论文提出Dream-RSI框架，用于可扩展且递归自我改进的探索。
evidence.quote: We introduce \textsc{Dream-RSI}, a framework for scalable and recursively self-improving exploration.

evidence.claim: 核心洞察是累积的发现历史可作为已实现搜索空间上的回放模拟器。
evidence.quote: Our key insight is that accumulated discovery history can serve as a replay simulator over the realized search space.

evidence.claim: 通过在回放模拟器中进行dreaming，Dream-RSI无需重复昂贵的在线评估即可获得低成本离线反馈来评估和改进探索策略。
evidence.quote: By performing dreaming in the replay simulator constructed from historical discovery trees, \textsc{Dream-RSI} secures immediate, low-cost off-policy feedback to evaluate and refine exploration policies without invoking repetitive, expensive online evaluations.

evidence.claim: 实验涵盖算法工程、数学优化和GPU核工程，并在若干设置中降低发现成本。
evidence.quote: Across algorithm engineering, mathematical optimization, and GPU kernel engineering, \textsc{Dream-RSI} achieves competitive or improved discovery quality while substantially reducing discovery cost in several settings.

experiments: 任务涵盖算法工程、数学优化和GPU核工程。
算法工程任务为Lasso正则化路径发现，目标是发现高效实现并保持数值正确性；使用与SimpleTES相同的17个合成实例进行发现，并在6个留出的下游数据集上评估泛化性。
基线包括sklearn、glmnet、SimpleTES以及受控基线Recursive Fixed Exploration；Recursive Fixed Exploration和Dream-RSI均运行5轮。

analysis.insight: 核心洞察是：累积的发现历史本身可以充当“回放模拟器”，对已实现的搜索空间进行离线重演和低成本评估。由于历史发现树中所有节点的结果已经存储，单次昂贵的在线运行可以支撑成千上万次零执行成本的离线策略评估，从而把原本稀缺、昂贵的反馈转化为可复用的策略改进信号。这使得元层探索策略的优化不再依赖重复的在线真实评估，突破了延迟与成本瓶颈，并通过不断扩充模拟器池形成递归自我改进闭环。

method: 在线探索阶段：当前探索策略引导编码智能体扩展发现树，记录每次尝试的完整轨迹，形成结构化发现树并加入历史集合。
构建回放模拟器：将生成的发现树转换为可复用的模拟器池，节点结果预先存储，支持对替代探索策略进行零执行成本回放。
基于做梦的策略改进：在回放模拟器中对大量候选策略进行离线评估；每个策略在每棵历史树上回放，选择批量子节点，回放确定性返回已记录的子节点，不生成新候选。
离线评估循环：在一个外层迭代内固定历史，构建并评估多个策略版本，从初始策略开始，利用回放反馈迭代改进。
重新部署：改进后的策略被重新部署到在线探索，驱动进一步发现，新产生的发现树扩充模拟器池，形成递归自我改进闭环。
编排层：轻量级编排层使探索策略显式化、可编程，同时底层编码智能体保持不变。
analysis.motivation: 递归自我改进是自主AI系统的重要目标，通常依赖迭代发现循环：生成候选解、评估、利用反馈改善后续迭代。随着能力提升和任务变难，发现过程需要在大搜索空间上进行长时程探索，可能跨越数千次提议-评估循环。此时如何编排探索成为瓶颈：固定策略难以适应搜索空间扩展，而在线策略优化需要在巨大元搜索空间下、在延迟且昂贵的反馈中导航。因此需要一种可扩展且能递归自我改进探索策略的框架。

figures.caption: Overview of Dream-RSI . The system operates in a recursive self-improvement loop via three core stages: ① Online Explore , where the current exploration policy guides a coding agent to expand a discovery tree and log historical traces; ② Construct Replay Simulator , where the generated discovery tree is converted into a reusable simulator pool; and ③ Dreaming-based Policy Improvement , where the agent "dreams" up a massive pool of alternative policies in its mind. It then feeds these candidate policies into the replay simulator to simulate executions and derive rapid feedback, continuously refining its strategy (detailed in the Zoom-in box). The updated policy then redeploys for the next round of online exploration.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Discovery history as a replay simulator. A deployed policy first explores online to generate a structured discovery tree containing historical execution traces (each node denote an attempt with its full observation). Thousands of candidate policies can then be tested within this simulator—evaluating alternative choices of search branches, exploration orders, concurrency levels, and stopping rules. Since all node outcomes are pre-stored, a single costly online run enables thousands of rapid, zero-execution-cost off-policy evaluations. This enables policy improvement through historical replay: the agent can “dream” over many alternative exploration strategies before redeploying the improved policy online.
figures.label: Figure 2

paper.abstract: Recursive self-improvement is becoming increasingly vital for autonomous AI agents, where progress hinges on discovering high-value solutions across complex domains. The driver of this process is effective exploration, however, managing and improving exploration strategies remains a major bottleneck. Current systems face a fundamental dilemma: fixed strategies fail to adapt as search spaces scale, while online policy optimization requires navigating vast meta-search spaces under delayed and expensive feedback over long-horizon rollouts. We introduce \textsc{Dream-RSI}, a framework for scalable and recursively self-improving exploration. A lightweight orchestration layer makes exploration explicit and programmable while leaving the underlying coding agent unchanged. Our key insight is that accumulated discovery history can serve as a replay simulator over the realized search space. By performing dreaming in the replay simulator constructed from historical discovery trees, \textsc{Dream-RSI} secures immediate, low-cost off-policy feedback to evaluate and refine exploration policies without invoking repetitive, expensive online evaluations. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed online to drive further discovery, continuously expanding the simulator pool in a self-improving loop. Across algorithm engineering, mathematical optimization, and GPU kernel engineering, \textsc{Dream-RSI} achieves competitive or improved discovery quality while substantially reducing discovery cost in several settings.
paper.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds

analysis.insight: MARC的有效性来自以条件互信息为信息论依据的消息正则化：通过最小化对未来系统状态的不确定性来构造学习信号，使消息朝着保留对预测未来状态最有价值的信息这一方向演化，而不是仅仅追求带宽占用小或重构局部观测。这种以“对未来状态的不确定性缩减”为目标的正则项，使协议在训练的非平稳过程中仍然趋向产生高代表性、且在被压缩或经有损信道传输后仍保留关键判别信息的消息，从而在严格通信瓶颈下维持协作性能。

analysis.motivation: 部分可观测的多智能体系统中，关键环境信息分散在网络各处，单个智能体无法直接感知，因此通信成为跨越局部局限、实现集体目标的关键桥梁。已有框架多依赖CTDE的集中式oracle，但在实际部署中受延迟、隐私和基础设施限制而往往不可行；同时物理信道存在带宽有限和信号噪声，要求智能体生成信息密集且能经受有损传输的消息。因此作者希望在CTDE范式下学习既具代表性又能鲁棒应对物理约束的通信协议，并解决所学消息在非平稳学习过程中保持稳定的挑战。

paper.abstract: Effective communication is a cornerstone of distributed intelligence in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), yet ensuring that generated messages are both informative and robust to physical constraints remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Regularized Communication (MARC), a novel framework inspired by information-theoretic principles of conditional mutual information. MARC employs an attention-based architecture coupled with a unique message regularization mechanism designed to minimize uncertainty regarding future system states, thereby inducing the learning of highly representative communication protocols. Crucially, we evaluate MARC under stringent communication bottlenecks and lossy channels, simulating the real-world constraints of autonomous robotic networks and decentralized systems. Our results demonstrate that MARC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in complex cooperative domains. Furthermore, we provide a deep analysis of message characteristics, proving that MARC maintains high operational performance even under significant data compression, offering a scalable path for deploying intelligent agents in resource-constrained environments.
paper.title: Robust and Efficient Communication for Multi-Agent Learning

analysis.setting: 一家以利润最大化为目标的电力零售商同时决定两件事：将一天划分为若干定价时段（时段划分决策 h）以及为每个时段设定价格水平 q，客户通过有效价格向量 p(q,h) 感知报价。每个客户（下层跟随者）在逐点上下界约束下重新安排用电负荷，并满足固定的日总用电量约束，同时选择一个被二次正则项惩罚的参与水平，客户也可以选择外部选项而拒绝该报价。目标是最大化零售商的期望利润，关键约束包括价格取值集合、时段划分集合、客户最优响应条件以及参与水平的有界性（0≤y≤1）。信息假设为零售商面对一组模拟客户，客户以最优响应方式反应；环境是单阶段（一个典型日）的静态优化设定，摘要未涉及多日动态扰动。

paper.abstract: We study the joint design of a time-of-use (ToU) tariff (the partition of the day into pricing blocks and the price level attached to each block) by a profit-maximizing electricity retailer facing flexible clients who may refuse the offer in favour of an outside option. The problem is modeled as a bilevel program in which each client, at the lower level, reshapes its consumption under pointwise bounds and a fixed daily energy total, and simultaneously chooses a participation level penalized by a quadratic regularizer. We prove the client's best response is computable in loglinear time. We derive two equivalent single-level reformulations: a closed-form continuous one tackled via stochastic gradient ascent (using a continuous reparametrization of block start times and durations) and a mixed-integer nonlinear program solved via dedicated solvers. The stochastic ascent scheme provides Clarke-critical accumulation points almost surely, in a scalable way. On a case study from the French retail electricity market with $5000$ simulated households, the gradient method matches a commercial mixed-integer solver on the pointwise problem to within $0.3\%$ of the optimal profit while running two to eight times faster on $100$ representative clients. Restricting unconstrained pointwise prices to admissible ToU schedules yields an estimated profit loss of $1.3\%$- $13.8\%$ for two-period tariffs and $0.6\%$-$6.6\%$ for three-period tariffs on the instances considered.
paper.title: Joint Design of Time-of-Use Schedules and Price Levels: a Bilevel Model with Client Participation and Load Flexibility

paper.abstract: UAVs have emerged as highly flexible platforms for data sensing in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). Path planning for UAVs in such tasks plays a key role to assure remote sensing effectiveness and friendly energy consumption. However, existing approaches show two key limitations: i) they are primarily hand-crafted with certain design biases that harm adaptation on unseen tasks. ii) they predominantly assume idealized spatial complexities of actual environments through simplified simulation, causing them to underperform during real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose a novel learning-assisted planning framework, termed Landscape-Aware Meta Differential Evolution (LAMDE), to tackle the mentioned limitations. The major contributions come from the following aspects. We first re-formulate such UAV path planning problem to embrace challenging constraints. To efficiently navigate this highly constrained space, we propose a bi-level learning to optimize approach, where the meta-level is a trainable algorithm configuration policy that meta-learns an adaptable planning strategy for low-level planning algorithm. To address the potential training data scarcity and distribution shift in real-world environments, we introduce a landscape-aware automatic augmentation scheme that enriches training data. At the low-level, a Differential Evolution algorithm is deployed for solving the path planning tasks. To enhance the solving flexibility, we further design a variable-length encoding strategy that dynamically prunes redundant hover points and optimizes continuous flight parameters concurrently within a unified search space. Based on all proposed designs, we meta-train LAMDE and compare it with representative baselines. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that LAMDE achieves state-of-the-art performance on the tested complex UAV path planning tasks in WSN data collection scenarios.
paper.title: Learning to Optimize UAV Path Planning for Data Sensing in Wireless Sensor Networks

paper.abstract: Manufacturing consumes one third of global energy and still has significant room for improvement in terms of energy efficiency. Optimal process control is essential for this purpose. However, synthesizing mathematical optimization models from messy, real-world industrial specifications requires bridging unstructured natural language and spatial diagrams with rigorous mathematical syntax. This poses a profound challenge for general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), which may introduce invalid constraints when tasked with modeling continuous multi-physics dynamics. To address this, we introduce little m, an AI agent designed to assist the formulation of industrial process control models. Combining a domain-specific knowledge repository with LLM-driven interaction, the proposed framework formulates real-world optimization problems as mathematical models. For systematic evaluation, we introduce the Industrial Process Control Benchmark (IPC-Bench), a novel multimodal dataset of 50 canonical scenarios requiring joint reasoning over text and process diagrams. Through comprehensive automated structural assessments and double-blind human evaluation, little m substantially outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs, generating semantically correct models. These evaluations assess formulation quality rather than solver feasibility, formal physical validity, or closed-loop industrial performance. The implementation of little m and the IPC-Bench dataset are available at https://github.com/yeyongchao/process-modeling-benchmark.
paper.title: little m: An AI Agent for Industrial Process Optimization

paper.abstract: Manufacturing consumes one third of global energy and still has significant room for improvement in terms of energy efficiency. Optimal process control is essential for this purpose. However, synthesizing mathematical optimization models from messy, real-world industrial specifications requires bridging unstructured natural language and spatial diagrams with rigorous mathematical syntax. This poses a profound challenge for general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), which may introduce invalid constraints when tasked with modeling continuous multi-physics dynamics. To address this, we introduce little m, an AI agent designed to assist the formulation of industrial process control models. Combining a domain-specific knowledge repository with LLM-driven interaction, the proposed framework formulates real-world optimization problems as mathematical models. For systematic evaluation, we introduce the Industrial Process Control Benchmark (IPC-Bench), a novel multimodal dataset of 50 canonical scenarios requiring joint reasoning over text and process diagrams. Through comprehensive automated structural assessments and double-blind human evaluation, little m substantially outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs, generating semantically correct models. These evaluations assess formulation quality rather than solver feasibility, formal physical validity, or closed-loop industrial performance. The implementation of little m and the IPC-Bench dataset are available at https://github.com/yeyongchao/process-modeling-benchmark.
paper.title: little m: An AI Agent for Industrial Process Optimization

paper.abstract: Post-disaster phasor measurement unit (PMU) outages reduce power-system observability and degrade operator situational awareness, requiring sequential restoration under limited resources. Existing PMU restoration methods based on optimization or heuristics can generate restoration schedules, but they often provide limited support for explanation, traceability, and operator interaction. This paper proposes an agentic tool-calling framework orchestrated by a large language model (LLM) for post-disaster PMU restoration and grid observability recovery. In this framework, the LLM does not directly solve the restoration optimization problem; instead, it coordinates validated backend tools required for post-disaster restoration, including observability assessment, restoration planning, state updates, and operator verification. The framework also maintains a structured tool-call history and execution context that keep restoration decisions traceable and explainable, while enabling context-aware operator question answering during the restoration process. Simulation results on IEEE 30-bus and IEEE 57-bus systems show that the proposed framework achieves observability recovery comparable to a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) solution, while providing tool-grounded explanations, interactive operator support, and human-overseen execution.
paper.title: Explainable Post-Disaster Grid Observability Recovery Using Human-Oversight Agentic LLMs

paper.abstract: This study proposes a Large Language Model-Driven Differential Evolution (LLMDE) algorithm to reduce the reliance on handcrafted hyperparameter design. The proposed algorithm leverages a prompt engineering strategy, allowing large language models (LLMs) to dynamically select mutation strategies and configure control parameters guided by optimization feedback, thus enhancing the performance of the DE algorithm. We evaluate the performance of LLMDE on the CEC2022 benchmark suite, comparing it with standard DE and representative metaheuristics. Furthermore, we employ factor analysis and K-means clustering for stock selection, and then apply LLMDE to solve the Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) portfolio optimization problem using the selected stocks, subject to budget and minimum expected return constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that LLMDE achieves competitive performance on the benchmark suite while continuously generating high-quality solutions for complex constrained optimization tasks. These outcomes successfully demonstrate the viability of embedding LLMs within metaheuristics, paving a promising path toward the design of advanced LLM-assisted optimization techniques.
paper.title: LLMDE: A Large Language Model-Driven Differential Evolution Algorithm for Portfolio Optimization

paper.abstract: The modernization of railway systems is being driven by the need for greater efficiency, sustainability, and intelligent operation. In this review, recent advancements in dynamic scheduling, energy management, and energy storage systems (ESSs) integration within electric railway networks are analyzed. Optimization strategies for train scheduling and operation control are reviewed, with a focus on methods that reduce energy consumption and improve overall system performance. The role of energy storage technologies is analyzed in terms of energy management, peak shaving, and voltage and frequency control for practical application. The integration of artificial intelligence and advanced control strategies is also reviewed in electrified railway systems. This review provides a comprehensive overview of current research trends and outlines future directions for the development of resilient, energy efficient, and intelligent railway systems with ESSs integration.

paper.abstract: Optimizing industrial process flowsheets is often computationally prohibitive due to the high cost of rigorous simulations and the curse of dimensionality inherent in complex design spaces. To address these challenges, we present a reduced-space multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (RS-MFBO) framework designed for high-dimensional, expensive black-box functions. The approach integrates Global Sensitivity Analysis (GSA) for dimensionality reduction with a fidelity-augmented Gaussian process that captures correlations between low-cost approximations and expensive high-fidelity evaluations. A cost-aware acquisition strategy, augmented with cooldown and promotion mechanisms, adaptively guides the allocation of samples across fidelities. The framework is validated on two distinct industrial process simulators: a plasmid DNA bioprocess in SuperPro Designer and a green fuel synthesis plant in Aspen HYSYS. Results across diverse economic and physical objectives demonstrate that the proposed method substantially reduces the number of high-fidelity simulator evaluations while maintaining competitive optimization performance compared to single-fidelity baselines. These results highlight RS-MFBO as a scalable, simulator-agnostic approach for cost-constrained black-box optimization.

paper.abstract: The Graph Coloring Problem (GCP) is NP-hard and DSATUR stands as one of the fastest heuristics for it despite producing colorings that typically use more colors than state-of-the-art coloring algorithms. We propose SSLD (Semidefinite Spectral Learning with DSATUR), which improves DSATUR by preprocessing a first good color class before letting DSATUR complete coloring the rest of the given graph. We obtain this color class from a Semidefinite Programming (SDP), similar to an SDP used to compute the Lov\'asz theta number. To the best of our knowledge, SSLD is the first approach to improve DSATUR by preprocessing through fixed color classes. We evaluate SSLD against DSATUR and against a naive 1-color-class preprocessing algorithm on DIMACS instances, random graphs (Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi, Watts-Strogatz, Barab\'asi--Albert), Frequency Assignment and Job Shop Scheduling instances. SSLD matches or beats DSATUR in almost every case across over 1600 benchmark instances, and out performs the naive GISD baseline, allows us to confirm the value brought by the SDP-guided choice of the first color class. This quality comes at a runtime cost of roughly 195 times slower that DSATUR, but demonstrating that SDP-guided preprocessing of a first color class is a direction for future improvements.
paper.title: One Color Preprocessing Improves DSATUR

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文本身研究的是数据中心功率调制的控制问题，而非生产调度或经典运筹优化中的柔性作业车间、流水车间等排程问题，因此它并不直接研究当前研究画像中的核心调度场景。然而其方法范式具有明确的迁移价值：分层滚动时域分解、固定慢决策后凸补偿子问题的对偶分解求解、以及用快速求解器为组合层候选评分的思想，可迁移到生产运输协同或分布式制造中的多时间尺度决策问题；例如在柔性作业车间中可把机器启停等慢速离散决策与工件加工速率等快速连续决策分层处理。这类迁移属于推测，需要满足慢决策与快决策时间尺度分离、快层子问题在固定慢决策后具有可分凸结构、以及能够在滚动时域中反复快速评估候选慢决策等条件。此外，排序前缀搜索用于压缩组合动作空间的做法，也可与生产调度中基于机器配置的邻域搜索结合，但同样需要验证约束可行性与公平计算预算。

paper.abstract: Cloud datacenters must increasingly modulate power in response to time-varying grid and infrastructure constraints. We study this problem as finite-horizon control of a networked hybrid dynamical system, where datacenter power and service capacity depend on interactions between servers, workers, and hosted services. Power can be reduced through fast continuous worker throttling, which acts immediately but degrades service capacity, and slow discrete server transitions, which provide deeper savings but evolve with delay. Coordinating these mechanisms yields a high-dimensional mixed-integer dynamic optimization problem which is intractable to solve at scale. We propose a hierarchical receding-horizon controller that separates slow server reconfiguration from fast throttling recourse. For fixed server states, the throttling layer reduces to a service-level convex recourse problem solved efficiently by dual decomposition. The server layer then uses a ranked-prefix search that evaluates candidate configurations through the recourse value over the planning horizon. Experiments on realistic instances with over 15,000 servers, 200,000 workers, and 1,400 services show that the controller satisfies time-varying power caps with no violations and substantially lower service impact than fast-only or slow-only baselines. Our method offers significant speedups compared to standard optimization solvers, computing near-optimal plans within a 20 second real-time control interval.
paper.title: Multi-Scale Datacenter Power Modulation

paper.abstract: This paper extends Mixed-Integer Differentiable Predictive Control (MI-DPC) to multi-modal discrete decisions and nonconvex polynomial dynamics arising in Underground Pumped Hydro Energy Storage Systems (UPHES). A neural policy mapping problem parameters to continuous setpoints and integer mode selections via a Gumbel-Softmax layer is trained in a self-supervised manner by differentiating the expectation of the finite horizon control objective through the nonlinear dynamics model. Three methodological contributions enable this extension: a parallel differentiable simulator that preserves gradient magnitude, a Transformer encoder that captures long-range temporal dependencies, and a Gumbel-Softmax temperature annealing schedule that regularizes the combinatorial search. We demonstrate the framework on day-ahead scheduling of a UPHES, a large-scale mixed-integer optimal control problem with nonlinear unit performance curves and volume-head coupling. MI-DPC achieves only 1.6% suboptimality relative to a piecewise mixed-integer quadratic programming baseline, while providing five orders of magnitude speedup in online scheduling time.

paper.title: Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Differentiable Predictive Control for Underground Pumped Hydro Energy Storage Systems

paper.abstract: Surrogate-assisted evolutionary algorithms (SAEAs) are effective methods for solving expensive optimization problems (EOPs), where surrogate models replace most expensive evaluations and critically influence the final optimization results. In recent years, tabular foundation models have advanced rapidly, and the Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) has been adopted as a surrogate model for EOPs due to its strong predictive capability, demonstrating promising performance. Motivated by its potential as a surrogate model in SAEAs, this work conducts a comprehensive study that combines extensive experiments with in-depth theoretical analysis to investigate the effectiveness of TabPFN. Specifically, we perform experiments across both offline and online SAEA settings, covering diverse problem scenarios such as single-objective, multi-objective, constrained, combinatorial, mixed-variable, and engineering optimization problems. In addition, we further analyze the advantages and limitations of TabPFN within SAEAs and provide practical guidelines for its application in different optimization settings. Results show that the effectiveness of TabPFN is highly problem dependent, and it cannot replace conventional surrogates universally. Overall, TabPFN should be adopted selectively according to data availability, landscape complexity, search space characteristics, and its role within the algorithm. Customized model management strategies and role-specific algorithm design are necessary to fully exploit its advantages and avoid its pitfalls.
paper.title: Benchmarking Tabular Foundation Models as Surrogates in Expensive Evolutionary Optimization

analysis.insight: 直接让大模型输出答案容易产生幻觉且不可验证，而让模型输出调用 MIP 优化库与约束接口的可执行 Python 代码，就能把正确性判断外包给求解器：生成结果是否可用由求解器实际求解结果决定，而不是由模型自我判断。这样，模型学习到的不是记忆的答案模式，而是如何组合模态级离散化原语与跨模态耦合约束，从而把语言模型的组合归纳能力锚定在可验证的数值优化执行之上。

analysis.motivation: 现有 TAMP 与 M³P 方法多依赖领域特定启发式或局部最优性、可微性等假设，常将任务规划与运动规划解耦，导致融合较弱；纯符号方法（如 PDDL）高层推理高效但难以处理连续可行性。MIP 虽提供统一框架，但针对非凸机器人任务构建可求解的近似离散化 MIP 公式通常需要人工、领域特定地完成，难以规模化。因此作者希望让 LLM 借助求解器反馈自动生成可执行的 MIP 建模代码，使语言推理与基于优化的规划真正衔接。
analysis.primary_topic: 大语言模型生成混合整数规划代码求解多模态运动规划，并用强化学习以求解器反馈进行训练
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实：该工作将大语言模型与混合整数规划求解器结合，用求解器可验证的结果驱动强化学习训练模型生成可执行优化建模代码，属于“学习辅助优化建模 + 求解器在环”的 AI4OR 路线，其问题域是多模态运动规划这一混合离散-连续决策问题，与生产调度中的离散-连续耦合、机器/工序选择、路径与序列耦合在结构上同类。迁移设想（推测）：要把这种“LLM 生成 MIP 代码 + 求解器反馈 RFT”的机制迁移到柔性作业车间、分布式制造或生产-运输协同调度，需要满足若干条件——存在可稳定执行并给出可行性/目标值的求解接口、任务可分解为可复用的离散化或建模原语、奖励可由求解结果自动给出，以及约束体系（工序先后、机器容量、运输时间、能耗与多目标）能表达为 MIP；动态扰动场景还需扩展建模或引入滚动时域。这些迁移均属推测，不是作者结论；论文本身未涉及生产调度实例。
analysis.setting: 论文研究多模态运动规划（M³P）问题，属于任务与运动规划（TAMP）的特例：机器人需要在离散工作模式（如抓取、行走、导航）之间切换，同时对连续运动进行联合推理，决策对象是模式序列与连续轨迹的联合解，目标是在混合离散-连续决策空间中生成可行且鲁棒的运动路径。关键约束包括符号约束与几何约束的紧耦合、非凸性以及需要采用近似、基于离散化的混合整数规划（MIP）形式。信息假设为环境为静态、模型与任务信息已知，作者在结论中明确指出该流程主要面向静态环境，不支持带移动障碍或时变约束的动态场景。

analysis.uncertainty: 输入为摘要加部分全文节选，缺少方法细节、训练超参、基线配置、消融实验与完整实验表格，因此对 GRPO 的具体奖励设计、MIP 形式的具体构造、计算预算与公平比较细节无法确认；真实硬件实验仅给出成功比例与失败归因，未给出统计细节。全文节选部分段落存在截断（如 PDDL 段落不完整），因此部分论证链细节未被覆盖。
analysis.why_recommended: 对研究 AI4OR 的博士生而言，这篇论文提供了一个清晰的范式：把“建模”本身作为学习对象，让 LLM 输出可执行的 MIP 建模代码，并用求解器结果作为可验证奖励来训练，从而绕开直接答案生成的幻觉问题。这一思路与自动化建模、学习辅助搜索、求解器在环优化高度契合，可类比迁移到作业车间与生产-运输协同调度的自动建模；同时它的评价方式（成功率、基线对比、真实硬件迁移、静态环境局限声明）也提供了处理约束可行性与泛化评估的参考。

figures.caption: M 3 P-R1 enables unified planning for diverse M 3 P tasks: multi-robot footstep planning, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) navigation, inverse kinematics (IK), and grasping, as well as their compositional combinations. By generating solver-grounded MIP programs, the method produces feasible and robust trajectories across heterogeneous robotic domains. Trajectories are shown as dotted lines, with blue spheres on the T-shaped object marking predicted grasp contact points.

figures.caption: M 3 P-R1 pipeline. The model is first supervised to generate structured MIP programs via a discretization API, then refined with GRPO using solver-verifiable rewards (format, API coverage, execution, and correctness). At inference, it maps natural language tasks to executable MIP code with intermediate reasoning, which is solved to yield feasible multi-modal plans.

paper.abstract: Multi-Modal Motion Planning (M$^3$P) requires joint reasoning over continuous motions and discrete mode transitions, making it difficult to solve efficiently. For instance, a bipedal robot may walk to a target location and then use its arms to grasp an object. This scenario captures both mode transitions and continuous dynamics, yielding feasible paths that neither purely discrete nor continuous planners can handle. While Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) offers a principled framework, constructing tractable formulations for non-convex problems is typically manual and domain-specific, especially in the approximate, discretization-based MIP regime needed for non-convex robotic tasks. We propose M$^3$P-R1, a reinforcement learning method that fine-tunes large language models (LLMs) to decompose M$^3$P tasks into MIP variables, constraints, and objectives. Instead of directly outputting answers, which are often prone to hallucination, the model generates executable Python code using MIP optimization libraries and constraint interfaces. This enables solver-backed execution for robust and verifiable solutions. Trained with an outcome-driven reward against the solver, M$^3$P-R1 learns to compose modality-level discretization primitives and synthesize cross-modal coupling constraints, producing executable MIP programs for complex M$^3$P tasks.
paper.title: M$^3$P-R1: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Guided Multi-Modal Motion Planning via MIP Code Generation

analysis.analysis: 作者先建立含多车多车道的交互式驾驶系统模型，将对偶 MPC 表述为含整数机动决策与连续运动的混合整数非线性规划(16)，并用对手可能交互的场景树处理多模态不确定性；随后把该 MINLP 表示为变量节点、约束节点和边构成的二部图，将求解最优整数决策的问题转化为图上的节点分类/分布预测问题，利用训练实例共享的结构先验，由GNN预测每个决策的最优值分布，再用置信度阈值固定部分整数变量，仅在剩余模糊变量上调用求解器（如SCIP）完成分支定界。
challenges: 混合整数非线性规划(16)为NP-hard，求解时间随交互场景复杂度急剧增长
多对手多车道下场景树规模膨胀，整数变量与连续运动耦合
需保持安全关键场景下预测决策的可解释性与最优性
需在固定高置信度决策时避免错误固定导致不可行或次优

analysis.insight: 整数机动决策（如换道、安全区域选择）刻画了交互的组合结构，且同一场景会反复求解结构相似的问题实例；用GNN从图结构中学习最优整数决策的分布、固定高置信度决策，可在几乎不损失最优性的前提下显著缩小分支定界搜索空间并抑制求解时间随交互复杂度的增长。

method: 构建多对手多车道对偶MPC问题(16)：联合优化整数机动决策（换道取{-1,0,+1}、安全区域取Q）与连续运动，场景树采样对手可能交互，目标包含跟踪与信息寻求
把(16)的变量、约束及其边关系建成图G，作为GNN输入；变量节点V与约束节点C先经各自MLP嵌入为V1、C1
约束侧消息传递：MLP由两端节点嵌入与边特征E计算每条边消息，约束节点聚合更新为C2；变量侧再聚合更新后的约束节点得到V2
最后由MLP把每个变量嵌入V2映射为标量分数，对组成决策z的二值变量分数做softmax，得到p_z(ζ)=Pr(z*=ζ)，换道无变化选项分数设为零
训练：在随机交通闭环仿真中收集每个MINLP的图G及其由SCIP求解全问题得到的最优机动决策{z*}，以交叉熵 -∑ log p_z(z*) 最小化训练GNN
推理：用GNN预测的分布固定高置信度整数决策，仅将模糊决策留给分支定界求解，得到缩减后的问题并求解
analysis.motivation: 对偶MPC可通过信息寻求动作减少对手行为不确定性，但其自动驾驶应用此前局限于单车道单一对手；扩展到多车道多反应型对手后，混合整数非线性规划的求解代价随交互复杂度急剧上升，需要降低计算负担以保持可实时性。
analysis.primary_topic: 混合整数对偶模型预测控制的学习加速求解
analysis.relation_to_research: 该文研究对象是自动驾驶中的对偶MPC混合整数规划求解，与智能优化、生产调度和AI4OR并非同一应用领域，但其“学习预测整数决策分布并固定高置信变量、缩小分支定界搜索空间”的机制与学习辅助搜索、求解器加速高度同源，具有明确迁移价值。推测：迁移到柔性作业车间、流水车间或生产运输协同调度时，需要把工序排序/机器分配/换道式的整数决策建模为相应二部图（变量-约束）并生成最优标签数据，同时验证固定决策后约束可行性、最优性损失与不同规模实例上的泛化；这些迁移条件需在调度问题上重新实验，不能直接视为作者结论。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为多车道道路上自车与多个反应型对手车辆交互的规划控制；决策对象包括整数型机动决策（换道与安全区域选择）和连续运动量，目标是在场景树采样下兼顾跟踪性能与对隐藏对手参数的不确定性削减，关键约束为混合整数非线性规划(16)及其安全/交互约束，信息假设为对手行为由隐藏参数驱动的多模态不确定性、场景树采样其可能交互，环境为动态闭环仿真中的交互式驾驶。
analysis.title_zh: GNN 加速的混合整数对偶 MPC 用于交互式驾驶
analysis.uncertainty: 本文应用领域为自动驾驶交互规划而非生产调度；全文节选未提供实验基线、实例规模、训练开销与公平计算预算等细节，也未说明错误固定时的恢复机制与置信度阈值选择，因此对其向调度问题迁移的实际收益和鲁棒性判断存在不确定性。
analysis.why_recommended: 对关注学习辅助精确求解的研究者而言，该文给出了一个清晰范式：将MINLP实例图化，用GNN预测整数变量最优值分布，再以置信度固定变量以加速求解；其“固定高置信整数决策、保留模糊变量给求解器”的思路可迁移到调度中的机器分配、工序排序等组合决策，且报告了固定比例、加速比与最优性损失的量化证据，同时保留可解释性，适合作为AI4OR中学习与数学规划结合的参考。

paper.abstract: In interactions with uncertain opponents, dual model predictive control (MPC) can improve performance through information-seeking actions that reduce uncertainty about opponents' behavior. Its recent applications to autonomous driving, however, are limited to scenarios involving a single opponent on a single lane. This paper presents a mixed-integer dual MPC for multiple reactive opponents on multi-lane roads, jointly optimizing integer-valued maneuver decisions (lane changes and safe-region selections), and continuous motion over a scenario tree that samples plausible interactions with the opponents. As interaction complexity increases, solving the resulting mixed-integer nonlinear program becomes increasingly expensive. To reduce this computational burden, a graph neural network (GNN) predicts the optimal maneuver decisions, and high-confidence predictions are fixed before the reduced problem is solved. Simulations show that active probing behavior emerges in complex interactive scenarios, and that GNN guidance fixes $76.3\%$ of the integer decisions and reduces the solve time by $2.5\times$ on average, with negligible degradation of optimality.
paper.title: GNN-Accelerated Mixed-Integer Dual MPC for Interactive Driving

paper.abstract: Two-stage stochastic Mixed-Integer Linear Programs are a canonical modeling tool to optimize power system operations under uncertainty, yet their extensive-form counterparts scale linearly with the number of scenarios and quickly become computationally prohibitive under day-ahead time constraints. We propose an Input Convex Neural Network architecture to learn a convex surrogate of the second-stage value function, enabling fast first-stage optimization while preserving convexity by construction. We couple the surrogate with a Neural-Benders correction loop that refines the first-stage solution a posteriori, recovering the exact optimum whether the network overestimates or underestimates the recourse cost, and certifying solution quality independently of surrogate accuracy. We evaluate the method on IEEE Stochastic Unit Commitment benchmarks (case9-case118) under both continuous and integer recourse. The proposed approach achieves solutions with zero optimality gap on the $K$-scenario instance across all test cases and scenario dimensions $K \in \{10, 50, 100\}$, with speedups up to $214\times$ over the Extensive Form in the integer setting. Solve times are stable across scenario realizations and compatible with day-ahead time windows on the tested benchmark instances.
paper.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Power Systems
paper.title: Learning to Solve Two-Stage Stochastic Unit Commitment Problems with Quality Guarantees

paper.abstract: The problem of multiobjective optimization under uncertainties is often approached by taking the expectation of each objective. In this work, we propose instead to formulate this as a Bayesian decision problem and to rely on the expected value of the hypervolume, which is to be maximized with respect to a finite set of input points. We show that this can be performed using methods based on gradients in a stochastic optimization framework, provided that care is taken with respect to dominated points. Moreover, in the absence of readily available differentiable code, we propose to use Gaussian Processes as differentiable surrogate models, in order to perform the optimization. An additional contribution in this work are some active learning strategies, through acquisition functions which helps construct a surrogate model well-designed for the multiobjective optimization problem at stake. These strategies are compared on simple analytical problems to assess their performances.
paper.title: Expected Hypervolume Maximization for Multiobjective Optimization under Uncertainties

analysis.analysis: 作者从问题结构出发，观察到 OCTSP 的复杂度可部分归约到簇内规模：利用簇的序列结构，方法可在簇大小而非整个实例大小的指数时间内求得精确解，从而把大规模问题分解为可管理的局部子问题，并借助学习加速的路径规划与并行子求解器协调求解。摘要未给出具体的下界、图表示或分解推导细节，材料未说明。

evidence.claim: 作者指出独立优化每个簇会忽略非局部依赖

evidence.claim: COMPASS 结合搜索与学习加速的路径规划，并编排并行子求解器
evidence.quote: We introduce the COMPASS algorithm for OCTSP, which combines search with learning-accelerated routing by orchestrating parallel sub-solvers.

evidence.claim: 方法无质量上限，解随算力增加持续改进
evidence.quote: COMPASS has no quality ceiling and its solutions keep improving with compute.

evidence.claim: 方法利用簇结构，精确求解时间对簇大小而非实例规模呈指数级
evidence.quote: It exploits the clustered structure, and can reach exact solutions in time exponential in cluster size rather than instance size.

evidence.claim: 方法接受一般距离矩阵，不限于坐标输入
evidence.quote: Unlike common large-scale routing solvers, COMPASS consumes general distance matrices and is not limited to coordinate inputs.

experiments: 与替代方法相比，COMPASS 持续取得更优表现
在 10 万合成节点上展示了可扩展性
在 2.85 万真实电商节点上进行了求解，作者称这是已知最大的非对称距离路径规划解，比已有 ATSP 基准规模大 9 倍
摘要未提供具体基线名称、解质量数值、运行时间、训练开销、计算预算公平性或消融实验，材料未说明
analysis.insight: 核心洞察在于：OCTSP 的困难来自簇间非局部依赖与簇内组合复杂性，而非实例整体规模。通过并行编排多个子求解器并结合学习加速的路径规划，算法既能利用簇结构缩小需精确求解的局部规模，又能保持搜索质量随算力持续提升，从而避免传统启发式方法的质量上限。

paper.abstract: Large-scale routing often requires visiting clusters of nodes in a prescribed order, giving rise to the Ordered Clustered Traveling Salesman Problem (OCTSP). Optimizing each cluster independently seems natural, but misses non-local dependencies. We introduce the COMPASS algorithm for OCTSP, which combines search with learning-accelerated routing by orchestrating parallel sub-solvers. COMPASS has no quality ceiling and its solutions keep improving with compute. It exploits the clustered structure, and can reach exact solutions in time exponential in cluster size rather than instance size. Empirically, COMPASS consistently outperforms alternative methods. Unlike common large-scale routing solvers, COMPASS consumes general distance matrices and is not limited to coordinate inputs. We demonstrate scaling to 100K synthetic nodes and to 28.5K real e-commerce nodes. To our knowledge, the latter is the largest reported routing solution over asymmetric distances, 9x beyond established ATSP benchmarks.
paper.title: COMPASS: Ordered Clustered Routing at 100K Scale

paper.abstract: Automated macro placement remains a fundamental challenge in VLSI physical design. Despite decades of research, existing approaches predominantly optimize hand-crafted proxy objectives, such as estimated wirelength, and typically produce placements through one-shot numerical optimization, limiting their ability to incorporate visual layout context, codified design expertise, and downstream physical-design feedback in a unified loop. We present PlaceReasoner-Beta, a verifier-guided multi-agent framework that reformulates macro placement as a closed-loop reasoning problem rather than black-box optimization. A vision-language model (VLM) planner generates candidate placements from the floorplan image, macro specifications, and connectivity structure; a geometric verifier enforces physical legality and expert placement principles; a physical verifier refines candidates using early implementation feedback; and a post-route optimizer further improves promising layouts using final PPA. To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce PlaceReasoner-Bench, a fully open end-to-end benchmark built from open RTL designs, EDA tools, and technology libraries. It comprises 8 designs at two aspect ratios, yielding 16 tasks with fixed floorplans and I/O assignments, so methods differ only in macro positions and orientations and are evaluated using routed PPA and DRC rather than pre-route proxies. Across the benchmark, PlaceReasoner-Beta achieves the best timing among DRC-clean methods on all square tasks, reducing post-route TNS by 61.2% at 1:1 and 53.0% at 2:1 relative to the classical baseline field. It also shortens routed wirelength on most designs despite never explicitly optimizing it, demonstrating that reasoning over spatial structure under physical-design feedback can improve end-to-end layout quality beyond proxy-objective optimization.
paper.title: PlaceReasoner-Beta: Reasoning-Driven Macro Placement and Benchmarking

paper.abstract: Many real-world optimization problems involve noisy objective evaluations and probabilistic constraints, particularly in the form of joint chance constraints, which are computationally expensive to evaluate. In this work, we propose CR-EA-C, a confidence-driven evolutionary algorithm for solving noisy black-box optimization problems under joint chance constraints. CR-EA-C introduces three key components: (1) analytical feasibility estimation for joint chance constraints, (2) a pairwise statistical ranking mechanism for robust comparison under noise, and (3) a modified infeasibility-driven survival strategy to accelerate convergence. These components enable statistically reliable decision-making while improving the efficiency of function evaluations. The proposed method is evaluated against four recent metaheuristic algorithms under various uncertainty distributions. Furthermore, its practical effectiveness is also assessed on two additional real-world optimization problems and compared with conventional static sampling methods. Experimental results show that CR-EA-C consistently satisfies the prescribed joint chance constraints while achieving competitive objective values overall. This demonstrates that CR-EA-C is an effective general-purpose approach for noisy optimization.
paper.title: A Confidence-Driven Evolutionary Algorithm for Noisy Optimization with Joint Chance Constraints

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文与智能优化、生产调度和AI4OR方向存在明确的迁移路径。论文本身不研究生产调度问题，但其核心机制——将优化求解器作为离线知识生成器训练神经代理模型以支持实时推理——可直接迁移到生产调度场景。例如，在柔性作业车间或流水车间调度中，可用MILP或约束规划求解器离线产生最优调度方案，训练图神经网络或强化学习代理模型来实时响应动态扰动。迁移条件包括：调度问题可被形式化为图结构（如析取图）、存在足够多样的训练实例、代理模型需满足可行性约束、以及推理延迟满足车间实时控制要求。需要指出，以上迁移到生产调度的设想是推测，论文作者并未讨论该方向。论文本身聚焦通信网络中继选择，与生产调度属于不同应用领域。相关性评分为6，因为它提供了可迁移的学习辅助搜索架构机制，但未直接研究调度问题。

paper.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming a fundamental design principle of future AI-native communication networks, enabling autonomous resource management, adaptive control, and zero-touch network operation. While current AI-native architectures increasingly embed intelligence across network functions, they provide little guidance on how optimisation knowledge should be systematically generated, transferred, and exploited by AI models. This paper argues that the Learning-to-Optimize (L2O) represents the missing architectural layer between optimisation and AI-native intelligence. Rather than viewing optimisation merely as an online decision engine, the proposed paradigm redefines optimisation algorithms as offline knowledge generators that produce high-quality supervisory information for neural surrogate models. The resulting models inherit optimisation expertise while enabling low-latency runtime inference suitable for dynamic network environments. A generic four-stage L2O workflow is introduced, comprising optimisation, knowledge generation, surrogate learning, and runtime inference. Unlike existing Learning-to-Optimize approaches, which primarily focus on algorithm acceleration, the proposed framework establishes L2O as an architectural abstraction applicable across heterogeneous communication and computing systems. The proposed paradigm is illustrated by an NR-V2X relay-selection problem, in which optimisation-generated solutions from a Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) solver are used to train a Graph Neural Network that can reproduce near-optimal decisions in real time. The presented perspective positions Learning-to-Optimize as a key architectural enabler for future AI-native networks.
paper.title: Learning-to-Optimize as the Missing Architectural Layer of AI-Native Networks

analysis.analysis: 作者利用 LQG 的结构性质进行分析：首先证明最优控制律仍是确定性等价的，且各智能体的控制律通过独立有限时域 Riccati 递推解耦，从而将联合控制与通信设计约化为仅对传输调度进行优化；随后用估计误差协方差的闭式刻画将调度目标表示为可计算的代价函数，并据此将滚动时域调度问题等价改写为混合整数线性规划；进一步通过窗口式跳传剪枝条件在求解 MILP 前安全地将连续传输决策固定为零，以缩小问题规模；最后基于单步传输收益得分设计拍卖式调度器，以局部信息近似全局耦合的调度决策。

集中式 MILP 调度随智能体数量增长计算时间以秒级增长，在线可扩展性受限

analysis.motivation: 网络化控制系统常在带宽、能量或接入受限的无线介质下运行，多智能体共享通信介质时连续传输所有传感器测量不可行。已有单智能体 LQG 通信受限控制结果表明最优控制器具有确定性等价结构，从而将联合控制与通信设计约化为对估计误差过程的调度；但多智能体共享网络容量时，即使智能体动力学解耦，通信决策仍通过网络容量全局耦合，形成困难的多智能体组合调度问题。论文旨在刻画该耦合结构并给出可扩展的调度方法。
analysis.primary_topic: 共享通信容量约束下多智能体事件触发 LQG 控制的传输调度优化
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文研究的是共享通信容量约束下的多智能体事件触发调度与 LQG 控制，属于通信受限网络化控制与组合资源分配的交叉方向。其核心决策是每步选择至多 C 个智能体传输的调度问题，与生产调度中在有限产能下选择任务的分配问题在结构上具有形式相似性；但论文的决策对象是传感器测量传输而非生产任务，约束是通信网络容量而非机器/工序约束，目标为 LQG 控制与通信代价而非完工时间、能耗或交货期。方法层面，将滚动时域调度问题建模为 MILP 并使用剪枝与拍卖启发式加速的思路，推测可迁移到生产调度中的在线资源分配与滚动重调度问题，但需要将估计误差协方差替换为调度问题特有的状态与目标函数，并重新验证约束可行性与解质量；论文未讨论生产调度、神经网络辅助求解、强化学习或多智能体智能体优化，也未给出与图神经网络、学习辅助搜索或进化算法的结合，因此迁移需谨慎设想。
analysis.setting: 论文研究一组动力学解耦的多智能体线性二次高斯（LQG）控制系统，各智能体共享一个每步传输容量有限的通信网络；每个子系统在每个时刻需要决定是否将其观测经网络传输给控制器，决策变量为传输调度变量 θ_{i,k}，目标是在有限时域内最小化控制代价与通信代价的加权总代价。关键约束是网络每步最多支持 C 个传输（容量约束），控制律与估计误差协方差演化耦合，但各智能体动力学独立；信息假设为初始状态与过程扰动为零均值高斯随机变量且协方差异构，调度为中心化决策；环境为有限时域随机最优控制问题，材料未说明是否为无限时域或在线滚动之外的其他动态机制。
analysis.title_zh: 共享通信约束下的多智能体事件触发 LQG 控制
analysis.uncertainty: 由于输入材料仅为摘要与部分全文节选，全文中的部分公式推导细节、剪枝条件的证明、拍卖式调度器的具体评分机制、MILP 的变量与约束完整形式、以及实验中的基线设置与消融分析未能完整获取；拍卖式调度器与 MPC 的 2.39% 代价差是否在不同 N、C、噪声水平下稳健，材料未说明；论文未提供与生产调度或学习辅助求解的直接关联证据，相关性判断为基于调度结构相似性的推断。
analysis.why_recommended: 该论文清晰刻画了共享资源约束下多智能体调度问题的结构分离性质——控制解耦而调度全局耦合，并给出了 MILP 等价表述与低复杂度拍卖启发式，这种“结构分析→MILP 建模→剪枝加速→启发式降复杂度”的研究范式对智能优化与生产调度中的组合资源分配问题具有方法论借鉴意义；其关于集中式最优与低复杂度启发式之间性能-计算复杂度折衷的实验设计（配对 MC 比较、代价分解、可扩展性测试）也为调度算法的公平计算预算评估提供了参考。尽管应用领域不同，但论文展示的如何利用问题结构分解、下界或局部收益评分来设计调度规则，与学习辅助搜索和智能体优化中的机制设计存在可迁移的共性。

paper.abstract: This letter studies event-triggered linear-quadratic-Gaussian (LQG) control for multi-agent systems sharing a communication network with limited per-step capacity. Although the agent dynamics are decoupled, the communication decisions are coupled through the shared network constraint, leading to a constrained multi-agent scheduling problem. We show that the optimal control law remains certainty-equivalent and decouples across agents through independent finite-horizon Riccati recursions, whereas the transmission schedule remains globally coupled. Based on this structure, we develop a centralized receding-horizon scheduling framework and reformulate the resulting problem as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) using a closed-form characterization of the estimation-error covariance. To improve scalability, we derive a window-based skip-pruning condition that safely fixes consecutive transmission decisions to zero before solving the MILP, and we propose an auction-inspired scheduler based on one-step transmission-benefit scores. Numerical results show that the proposed model predictive control (MPC) scheduler achieves the best trade-off between control performance and communication cost, while the auction-based scheduler attains performance close to MPC with substantially lower computational complexity.
paper.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026), Honolulu, Hawaii, USA
paper.title: Multi-Agent Event-Triggered LQG Control under Shared Communication Constraints

analysis.analysis: 作者通过一个共享的集成接口将四种已发表的原始启发式接入 HiGHS，为每个启发式设置独立的预算和耐心，并让它们各自在独立随机种子的工作线程上并行运行，从而利用机制互补来加速可行解构造。评估方面，作者在 mipfeas 基准的 233 个实例、600 秒时限下，与在同一台机器上单独构建的未打补丁 HiGHS 进行对比，并以原始积分、时限内解质量、在打补丁求解器能而原始求解器不能找到解的实例数以及最终 gap 等指标衡量效果，同时区分全量实例与未用于调参的实例。
challenges: 在求解器内部统一集成机制差异较大的多种原始启发式
为每个启发式设置合理的预算与耐心以平衡收益与计算开销
在并行、独立种子的工作线程间协调以避免无效重复搜索
在公平计算预算下与未打补丁的求解器进行可比评估
部分启发式在实际全时限运行中未产生被接受的 incumbent

analysis.insight: 作者的核心做法是让多个来源不同、机制互补的原始启发式共享统一的集成接口，并各自在独立随机种子的工作线程上并行运行，通过逐启发式的预算与耐心控制资源开销；许多启发式往往最先能提供一个可行解，进而改善原始积分，因此把不同机制的启发式并行集成起来，比依赖单一启发式更可能尽早找到可行解。这一有效性来自机制互补与并行多样性的结合，而非某一模块本身。

analysis.primary_topic: 混合整数规划的原始启发式（primal heuristics）实现与计算评估
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文属于 MIP 求解器内部的原始启发式工程与计算评估，与智能优化、生产调度以及学习辅助搜索有可迁移的关联。具体而言，其“多启发式共享接口 + 逐启发式预算与耐心 + 独立种子并行”的集成框架，是一种针对可行解构造的启发式组合策略，可能迁移到生产调度（如柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造与生产运输协同）中快速构造可行调度解的场景。但需要明确：作者并未研究生产调度问题，也未使用神经网络、强化学习、多智能体或大模型智能体；迁移到调度问题属于推测，需要满足的前提包括将调度约束映射为 MIP 或类似的传播/修复结构、为调度实例重新设计预算与耐心参数，并在公平计算预算下重新评估原始积分与约束可行性。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是在开源混合整数规划求解器 HiGHS 中实现并集成四种已发表的原始启发式（Feasibility Jump、fix-propagate-repair 及其 LP 引导的 dive-time 变体、LocalMIP、一阶 LP feasibility pump Scylla），目标是更快地为混合整数规划实例找到可行解并改善原始积分（primal integral）。决策对象是为给定 MIP 实例在求解过程中构造可行的原始解（incumbent）。关键约束包括每个启发式各自的预算与耐心（patience）设定、共享的集成接口，以及每个启发式在独立随机种子的工作线程上并行运行。信息假设是求解器在求解过程中可用的 LP、传播与当前可行解信息，材料未给出更细的假设。环境为静态的离线基准评测（mipfeas 基准），材料未说明动态扰动设定。
analysis.title_zh: HiGHS 中的预求解启发式：实现与计算研究
analysis.uncertainty: 证据仅限标题与摘要，未提供全文，因此无法了解各启发式的内部机制、集成接口的具体细节、并行实现方式、参数取值以及实验是否包含更细的基线与消融；对迁移到生产调度的适用性属于推测。
analysis.why_recommended: 对关注约束可行性、可行解快速构造和求解器工程的研究者，该论文提供了在开源求解器中集成多种原始启发式的参考实现与计算评估，其按启发式分配预算、耐心和并行种子的接口设计思路，可启发将学习辅助搜索或启发式组合机制迁移到生产调度与 AI4OR 场景，并强调公平计算预算下的评估。

paper.abstract: We present reference implementations of four published primal heuristics for mixed-integer programming inside the open-source solver HiGHS (Huangfu and Hall, 2018): Feasibility Jump (Luteberget and Sartor, 2023), fix-propagate-repair (FPR; Salvagnin, Roberti and Fischetti, 2025) with its LP-guided dive-time variant, LocalMIP (Lin, Zou and Cai, 2024), and the first-order-LP feasibility pump Scylla (Mexi et al., 2025). They share one integration interface with per-heuristic budgets and patiences, and each runs in parallel on independently seeded workers. The evaluation is on the mipfeas benchmark (Bussieck and Dirkse, 2026), 233 instances at 600 s, against a separately built unpatched HiGHS on the same machine. The primal integral improves by 23.7% over the full set and by 12.9% on the instances not used for tuning: the patched solver reaches a good solution sooner. At the time limit it is slightly ahead. It finds a solution on 4 instances where the unpatched solver finds none, against 1 the other way, and its final gap is smaller, significantly so only over the full set. Scylla and the LP-guided dive produced no accepted incumbent in any full-limit run that carried them and ship disabled; their implementations remain. The implementation is released as open source.
paper.title: Presolve heuristics in HiGHS: implementation and computational study

analysis.analysis: 材料未说明作者如何具体利用问题结构、分解、下界或图表示来设计求解方法；摘要层面仅说明作者依据运筹优化建模对可复用技能的需求，设计了分层技能库与批量级测试时演化机制，并以求解器验证作为经验是否可入库的判定依据。
challenges: 如何把求解器验证过的经验表示为可跨问题叙述迁移的可复用建模技能
如何分层组织问题级整体骨架与步骤级局部防错规则
如何在测试时演化技能库并保证候选技能只在验证通过后纳入，避免不可靠经验污染
如何在不同大语言模型骨干上稳定提升表述准确率

evidence.claim: 论文研究的是让大语言模型把自然语言决策问题翻译为正确数学规划的自动化运筹优化建模问题。
evidence.quote: Automated operations research (OR) modeling requires LLMs to translate natural-language decision problems into correct mathematical programs.

evidence.claim: 现有方法孤立求解问题，很少保留可复用经验并重复相似的建模错误。
evidence.quote: Existing methods can improve individual formulations, but they often solve problems in isolation, retaining little reusable experience and repeating similar formulation errors.

evidence.claim: 论文提出 OptiSkill，为基于大语言模型的运筹优化建模构建分层且演化的 SkillBank。
evidence.quote: We propose OptiSkill, a skill-augmented framework that builds a hierarchical and evolving SkillBank for LLM-based OR modeling.

evidence.claim: SkillBank 存储经求解器验证的经验，并分为问题级全局策略与步骤级经验两个层级。
evidence.quote: SkillBank stores solver-verified experience as reusable skills, with Global Strategies for problem-level formulation skeletons and Step Experiences for local error-prevention rules.

evidence.claim: 技能库通过稳定的批量级测试时演化进行细化，候选技能仅在验证通过后才被纳入。
evidence.quote: It is further refined through stable batch-level test-time evolution, where candidate skills are incorporated only after validation.

evidence.claim: 在八个运筹优化建模基准上，OptiSkill 在多个大语言模型骨干上提升表述准确率并优于强智能体基线。
evidence.quote: Experiments on eight OR modeling benchmarks show that OptiSkill improves formulation accuracy across LLM backbones, outperforms strong agentic baselines, and gains further by expanding SkillBank coverage and reliability.

experiments: 在八个运筹优化建模基准上进行实验
结果显示 OptiSkill 在多个大语言模型骨干上提升了表述准确率
优于强智能体基线（strong agentic baselines）
扩大 SkillBank 的覆盖范围与可靠性可带来进一步提升
摘要未提供具体数值、实例规模、运行时间、训练开销、公平计算预算、泛化与消融的细节
analysis.insight: 作者的核心洞察在于：仅仅存储示例或思路不足以支撑运筹优化建模，真正可迁移的是经过求解器验证的“建模技能”。通过把经验按粒度分层——问题级策略负责整体表述骨架、步骤级经验负责局部防错规则——经验才能既指导全局结构又约束具体决策；再通过稳定的批量级测试时演化并只接纳通过验证的候选技能，使技能库在扩展覆盖面的同时维持可靠性，从而减少重复性表述错误。

分层设计：Global Strategies 提供问题级表述骨架，Step Experiences 提供局部防错规则
通过稳定的批量级测试时演化（batch-level test-time evolution）对技能库进行细化
候选技能只有在验证通过后才被纳入技能库
analysis.motivation: 现有方法虽能改进单个模型表述，但往往孤立地求解问题，几乎不保留可复用经验，并会重复相似的建模错误；已有的基于记忆的方法存储示例、思路或见解作为参考，而运筹优化建模实际需要的是能跨问题叙述迁移并可指导具体建模决策的可复用建模技能。
analysis.primary_topic: 基于大语言模型的自动化运筹优化建模与可复用建模技能库
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文直接研究大语言模型驱动的自动化运筹优化建模，属于 AI4OR 中自动建模方向。它与本研究画像中的方法关注点（学习辅助搜索、数学规划与大语言模型/智能体的结合）有明确交集：分层技能库可作为可复用建模知识来源，为生产调度问题（如柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造）的自动建模与约束表达提供支持。不过，论文本身未涉及生产调度问题，也未涉及强化学习、图神经网络或多智能体协作，因此迁移到生产调度属于推测：需要验证技能库能否覆盖调度问题特有的目标函数、时序与资源约束，以及能否与求解器/搜索算法在给定计算预算下协同工作。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是由大语言模型将自然语言描述的决策问题自动翻译为正确的数学规划模型（自动化运筹优化建模）。决策对象是模型构建过程中的表述选择与错误防范规则；目标是在多个运筹优化建模基准上提高表述准确率。关键约束是所积累的经验必须经过求解器验证后才可复用，技能只有在验证通过后才被纳入技能库。信息假设方面，材料提出运筹优化建模需要可跨问题叙述迁移的可复用建模技能，而非孤立的示例、思路或见解，但未说明具体的问题规模、约束类型或数据生成方式。环境方面，材料给出的是静态基准评测与批量级测试时演化设定，未说明是否涉及在线动态扰动。

paper.abstract: Automated operations research (OR) modeling requires LLMs to translate natural-language decision problems into correct mathematical programs. Existing methods can improve individual formulations, but they often solve problems in isolation, retaining little reusable experience and repeating similar formulation errors. Prior memory-based approaches store examples, thoughts, or insights as references, while OR modeling requires reusable formulation skills that transfer across problem narratives and guide concrete modeling decisions. We propose OptiSkill, a skill-augmented framework that builds a hierarchical and evolving SkillBank for LLM-based OR modeling. SkillBank stores solver-verified experience as reusable skills, with Global Strategies for problem-level formulation skeletons and Step Experiences for local error-prevention rules. It is further refined through stable batch-level test-time evolution, where candidate skills are incorporated only after validation. Experiments on eight OR modeling benchmarks show that OptiSkill improves formulation accuracy across LLM backbones, outperforms strong agentic baselines, and gains further by expanding SkillBank coverage and reliability. Code and data are available at https://github.com/rachhhhing/OptiSkill
paper.title: OptiSkill: A Hierarchical and Evolving SkillBank for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling

paper.abstract: Two-dimensional irregular bin packing combines combinatorial bin-assignment decisions with difficult geometric feasibility constraints, making exact optimization challenging. This paper develops an exact combinatorial Benders decomposition framework for the two-dimensional irregular bin packing problem with convex polygons, coupling a pattern-based master problem with an exact single-bin geometric feasibility oracle. The dynamically strengthened Benders master is solved by a tailored exact branch-and-price procedure that incorporates objective-layered search and adaptive exact pricing. Geometric information obtained from the oracle is further fed back to the master and pricing processes through dynamically generated Benders feasibility cuts, which progressively restrict the subsequent pricing problems. Computational experiments are conducted on 540 benchmark instances from 18 classes. The proposed method obtains the optimal solution for 318 instances across 12 classes within a 3600-second time limit. On these classes, the proposed method solves more instances than a direct mixed-integer programming formulation and a baseline combinatorial Benders decomposition approach.
paper.title: A Combinatorial Benders Decomposition Framework for Two-Dimensional Irregular Bin Packing Problems with Convex Polygons

paper.abstract: We give a fixed parameter tractable (FPT) algorithm with running time $f(k,\Delta)\cdot {|I|}^{O(1)}$ for integer linear programs with 4-block structure, parameterized by the maximum block dimension $k$ and the largest absolute matrix entry $\Delta$. This result resolves a long-standing open question in parameterized complexity, and answers a conjecture by Eisenbrand and Rothvoss (2026) in the positive. This result has several implications for other block-structured integer programming models, including 3-block, mixed fracture number, and special cases of 4-block programs with large entries outside of the diagonal. Important tools for this algorithm are structural properties of generalized $n$-fold integer programs shown by Ligthart~(2026) and an algorithm by Veselov et al.~(2020) for optimizing discrete convic functions.
paper.title: A Fixed-Parameter Algorithm for 4-Block Integer Programming

analysis.analysis: 作者将种群多样性管理转化为行为空间中的分层代表选择问题：用六个算子级描述符刻画程序行为，按行为得分分层，并从每层中选择适应度有竞争力且紧凑的代表进入当前代档案；进而区分固定档案策略与自适应档案策略，后者依据训练适应度和标准化行为离散度信号决定是否使用档案父代，并可选地加入树大小条件。材料未说明是否使用问题结构分解、下界或图表示。

如何在适应度压力与行为多样性之间平衡
如何设计档案策略以选择兼具适应度竞争力和行为代表性的程序
需要公平比较多种档案策略在多个随机种子下的性能与程序规模

analysis.primary_topic: 遗传规划学习引导局部搜索及其种群多样性管理
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文属于学习辅助搜索与进化算法结合的方向，具体研究遗传规划学习引导局部搜索用于车辆路径问题。与生产调度和智能优化方向的关联是间接但可迁移的：其行为描述符、档案选择和自适应激活机制原则上可用于学习引导的调度局部搜索。但迁移到柔性作业车间、流水车间或分布式制造等生产调度问题属于推测，需要重新定义行为描述符、邻域算子以及适应度/行为信号，并在调度约束可行性和多目标环境下验证。
analysis.setting: 论文研究车辆路径问题（VRP）中遗传规划引导局部搜索（GPGLS）的种群多样性管理问题：决策对象是进化中的引导程序（utility functions），目标是在学习能够指导局部搜索的效用函数的同时维持种群多样性；关键约束或机制假设是程序可以具有相似适应度但诱导不同的搜索行为，因此在局部搜索过程中收集六个算子级行为描述符；环境为静态的生成式200客户VRP实例，信息假设与动态/静态扰动的具体设定材料未说明。
analysis.title_zh: 基于行为小生境的遗传规划用于车辆路径问题中的学习引导局部搜索
analysis.uncertainty: 仅有标题和摘要，无法确认行为描述符的具体定义、档案规模、参数设置、训练开销、计算预算公平性以及实例生成分布；无法判断该方法在更复杂约束或动态扰动下的表现；相关性判断为6，因为其核心是VRP上的GPGLS，而非生产调度或AI4OR直接问题，但机制具有明确的迁移路径。
analysis.why_recommended: 对关注学习辅助搜索、进化算法与局部搜索结合的研究者有参考价值：它指出了一个常见问题，即仅用适应度管理种群多样性可能不足，并给出了基于行为分层和档案选择的机制设计。虽然实验仅在车辆路径问题上，但其行为小生境和自适应档案策略的概念可以启发生产调度中学习引导局部搜索的多样性维护，且论文对结论边界和归因保持了谨慎。

figures.label: Figure 2

paper.abstract: Genetic Programming Guided Local Search (GPGLS) learns utility functions that guide local search for vehicle routing. Its evolving programs can have similar fitness while inducing different search behaviour, making fitness alone an incomplete basis for population diversity management. We propose GPGLS with Behaviour-based Niching (BN-GPGLS), which characterises programs through six operator-level descriptors collected during local search. A current-generation archive selects fitness-competitive, compact representatives from strata of a behaviour score. Fixed policies use archive parents continuously, whereas adaptive policies activate them using training-fitness and standardised behaviour-dispersion signals, optionally with a tree-size condition. We compare four behaviour-based variants with a no-archive GPGLS control and fitness-based niching over 30 seed-matched runs on generated 200-customer instances. BN-Adaptive achieves the best descriptive average rank on a separate 90-instance monitoring set; aggregate routing-cost differences are small. All five archive policies produce lower final-population median tree sizes than the GPGLS control, with paired Wilcoxon comparisons remaining significant after Holm adjustment. These results identify useful solution-quality and program-size trade-offs within the evaluated setting, without attributing the size reductions to behaviour representation alone.
paper.title: Genetic Programming with Behaviour-based Niching for Learning Guided Local Search in Vehicle Routing Problems

analysis.analysis: 作者将问题定位为训练数据选择与排序问题：GPGLS 的学习瓶颈在于评估代价高导致只能使用小批量，而批次的难度顺序是关键控制变量。作者没有把难度视为实例的固有属性，而是从当前种群在每个训练实例上的解质量出发估计难度，并在演化过程中持续更新这些估计。在此基础上，每一代选择一个接近预定难度水平的批次，并加入限制同一实例重复选择的修正机制，从而把课程学习从固定阶段顺序转变为随演化动态调整的难度调度。摘要未说明难度估计的具体形式、调度函数或修正机制的具体实现细节。
challenges: 如何在仅有当前种群解质量的条件下稳定地定义并估计每个训练实例的难度，而非依赖事先定义的实例属性。
如何在演化过程中动态更新难度估计，并据此组织每一代的训练批次，而不引入额外的大量评估开销。
如何在保证批次难度符合当前课程水平的同时，避免同一实例被反复选择导致训练分布退化和过拟合。
如何在固定训练-测试划分下、在等价 evaluator calls 预算内公平比较不同训练策略，并验证泛化改善的显著性。

evidence.claim: GPGLS 因评估每个 GP 个体在每个训练实例上的代价高，通常只用小实例批次训练。
evidence.quote: Evaluating every GP individual on every training instance at every generation is expensive, so GPGLS is usually trained on small instance batches.

evidence.claim: 已有课程式 GPGLS 主要按实例规模排序批次，ACL-GPGLS 虽自适应调整阶段切换时机，但实例难度顺序仍预先定义。
evidence.quote: Existing curriculum-based GPGLS orders these batches mainly by instance size. Adaptive Curriculum Learning GPGLS (ACL-GPGLS) improves training efficiency by adapting when the search moves between fixed curriculum stages, but the instance difficulty order remains predefined.

evidence.claim: DCL-GPGLS 的核心机制是从当前种群的解质量估计每个训练实例的难度，并在演化过程中更新这些估计。
evidence.quote: We propose DCL-GPGLS, which estimates the difficulty of each training instance from the current population's solution quality and updates the estimates during evolution.

evidence.claim: 每代选择接近计划难度水平的批次，并通过修正限制同一实例被反复选中。
evidence.quote: Each generation then receives a batch near a scheduled difficulty level, with a correction that limits repeated selection of the same instances.

evidence.claim: 在 CVRPLIB X 固定训练-测试划分上，DCL-GPGLS 在六种训练策略中取得最佳平均排名与平均测试成本。
evidence.quote: Experiments on a fixed training-test split of the CVRPLIB X set show that DCL-GPGLS achieves the best observed average rank and mean test cost among six training policies.

evidence.claim: DCL-GPGLS 在 65 个未见测试实例中的 36 个上取得最低平均成本。
evidence.quote: It obtains the lowest mean cost on 36 of 65 unseen test instances

evidence.claim: 在与静态反馈导出课程且总 evaluator calls 匹配的比较中，DCL-GPGLS 在 6 个实例上显著更优，其余 59 个无显著差异。
evidence.quote: and is significantly better than the static feedback-derived curriculum, matched in total evaluator calls, on 6 instances, with no significant difference on the remaining 59.

experiments: 在 CVRPLIB X 集合的固定训练-测试划分上进行实验，比较六种训练策略。
DCL-GPGLS 在六种训练策略中取得了最佳观测平均排名与平均测试成本。
在 65 个未见测试实例中，DCL-GPGLS 在 36 个实例上取得最低平均成本。
在与静态反馈导出课程、总 evaluator calls 匹配的比较中，DCL-GPGLS 在 6 个实例上显著更优，其余 59 个实例上无显著差异。
摘要未提供具体成本数值、实例规模区间、运行时间、训练开销、消融实验细节或统计检验方法等。
analysis.insight: 核心洞察在于：实例的“难度”不应被视为由实例规模等静态属性决定的先验量，而应由当前种群在该实例上的解质量反映出的、随演化进程变化的关系量。种群在不同实例上的相对表现提供了关于哪些实例当前最具训练价值的信号；随着种群能力提升，同一实例的相对难度会变化。因此，动态地估计并调度难度，让每代批次落在接近当前应有难度水平的位置，并加以修正避免同一实例被反复选中，可以在同等评估预算下让训练分布更适应种群当前状态，从而提升最终效用函数在未见实例上的表现。
limitations: 材料未说明作者明确陈述的局限；仅可注意到摘要未报告具体成本数值、实例规模分布、训练时间开销与消融分析。
method: 沿用 GPGLS 框架：用遗传规划演化引导局部搜索的效用函数，用于求解大规模车辆路径问题。
难度估计：根据当前种群在训练实例上的解质量估计每个训练实例的难度，而不是依据实例规模等预设属性。
动态更新：难度估计在演化过程中随种群变化而更新，使课程反映种群当前状态。
批次调度：每一代选择一批难度接近当前计划难度水平的训练实例。
选择修正：加入修正机制以限制相同实例被反复选择，避免训练分布过于集中。
公平比较：与静态反馈导出课程在总 evaluator calls 匹配的条件下进行比较。
analysis.motivation: 现有 GPGLS 的训练因需对每个 GP 个体在每代对每个训练实例评估而非常昂贵，通常只能用小的实例批次训练，导致训练效率和对大规模实例的泛化受限。已有的课程式 GPGLS 主要依赖实例规模排序，自适应课程学习 ACL-GPGLS 虽能自适应地调整在固定课程阶段间的切换时机，但实例难度顺序仍由人为预先定义。作者希望用数据驱动的方式、依据种群当前的求解表现估计实例难度，并随演化动态更新，使每代训练批次更贴近当前学习所需的难度水平。
analysis.primary_topic: 学习辅助组合优化训练策略：用动态课程学习提升遗传规划引导局部搜索在大规模车辆路径问题上的训练效率与泛化
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文面向大规模车辆路径这一组合优化问题，使用遗传规划演化启发式规则并用引导局部搜索求解，属于学习辅助搜索与超启发式范畴，与智能优化和 AI4OR 的研究主线直接相关。它不涉及生产调度本身，也未使用神经网络、图神经网络、强化学习或多智能体，因此与本研究画像中神经网络辅助求解、强化学习调度等方向的直接方法重叠有限。可迁移之处在于其训练数据调度机制：在生产调度或流水车间问题中，若以学习型启发式或演化规则训练求解器，同样面临“评估代价高、只能用小子集训练”的瓶颈，此时用当前种群在实例上的表现动态估计难度并调度训练批次，可能是一个可迁移的训练策略；但这一迁移属于推测，需要把难度信号从“路径问题的解质量”重新定义到调度问题的目标值与约束可行性等指标上，并在固定评估预算下验证其泛化增益。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是在大规模车辆路径问题（LSVRP）上训练遗传规划引导局部搜索（GPGLS）时，如何以有限的计算预算选择和排序训练实例批次，从而提升演化出的效用函数在未见测试实例上的求解质量。决策对象是每一代用于训练 GP 个体的实例批次，目标是提升测试成本意义上的解质量并保持与基线相同的评估预算。关键约束在于对每个 GP 个体在每个训练实例的每次评估代价昂贵，因此只能使用小批量训练，且比较需在相同 evaluator calls 预算下进行。信息假设包括可获得当前种群在每个实例上的解质量作为难度估计信号，以及存在训练-测试固定划分的 CVRPLIB X 实例集。环境方面，论文处理的是静态的离线训练-测试划分，但难度估计随演化过程动态更新，属于训练过程动态而问题实例静态的设定。
analysis.title_zh: DCL-GPGLS：面向大规模车辆路径的遗传规划引导局部搜索的动态课程学习
analysis.uncertainty: 仅能依据标题与摘要判断，未提供全文，因此难度估计的具体形式、批次调度与修正机制、实验统计方法与超参数设置均不可知；实验结论的规模适用范围、训练开销和是否在更大规模或动态问题上验证，均无法从摘要确认。相关性评分基于其学习辅助搜索与训练策略价值，而非方法层面与神经网络、强化学习或生产调度的直接重合。
analysis.why_recommended: 推荐给关注学习辅助组合优化、超启发式训练效率与泛化的研究者。论文把课程学习从静态的实例规模排序推进到基于种群表现的动态难度估计，并强调在匹配评估预算下与静态课程比较，这种对训练数据调度、计算预算公平性与泛化验证的处理方式，对训练型启发式或学习辅助搜索方法具有方法论参考价值。虽然不直接处理生产调度，但“难度随学习者状态动态变化”的思路可启发调度问题中训练实例的选择与排序设计。

figures.caption: DCL-GPGLS across generations. A selected instance batch and the current GP population are evaluated by GLS. The resulting tree fitness guides GP evolution, while the population-best gap on each selected instance updates its difficulty estimate for later batch selection.
figures.label: Figure 1

paper.abstract: Genetic Programming Guided Local Search (GPGLS) uses genetic programming to evolve utility functions for guided local search in large-scale vehicle routing problems (LSVRPs). Evaluating every GP individual on every training instance at every generation is expensive, so GPGLS is usually trained on small instance batches. Existing curriculum-based GPGLS orders these batches mainly by instance size. Adaptive Curriculum Learning GPGLS (ACL-GPGLS) improves training efficiency by adapting when the search moves between fixed curriculum stages, but the instance difficulty order remains predefined. We propose DCL-GPGLS, which estimates the difficulty of each training instance from the current population's solution quality and updates the estimates during evolution. Each generation then receives a batch near a scheduled difficulty level, with a correction that limits repeated selection of the same instances. Experiments on a fixed training-test split of the CVRPLIB X set show that DCL-GPGLS achieves the best observed average rank and mean test cost among six training policies. It obtains the lowest mean cost on 36 of 65 unseen test instances and is significantly better than the static feedback-derived curriculum, matched in total evaluator calls, on 6 instances, with no significant difference on the remaining 59.
paper.title: DCL-GPGLS: Dynamic Curriculum Learning for Genetic Programming Guided Local Search in Large-Scale Vehicle Routing

analysis.analysis: 作者从MILP建模角度分析连通性约束的编码方式：通过表2对比不同k-hop连通性方法在二进制变量、连续变量、不等式约束数量上的渐近复杂度，并论证流编码的必要性与充分性以保证对所有可能网络拓扑的覆盖。随后用统计评估方法分析理论复杂度与实际求解性能之间的差距，指出性能差距来自分支定界各节点上LP松弛的求解代价，与流编码引入的O(n_a^4 k)连续变量和不等式约束增长一致。
challenges: SEC方法的约束数量随MAS规模指数增长，限制可求解规模
k-hop连通性的既有矩阵幂方法二进制变量随跳数k增长
流编码引入大量连续变量与不等式约束，可能拖慢分支定界每节点的LP松弛求解

连通性约束需同时保证必要性与充分性以覆盖所有可能的网络拓扑

analysis.motivation: 网络化多智能体系统的连通性维护在MILP运动规划中通常用子回路消除（SEC）约束建模，其不等式约束数量随系统规模呈指数增长，限制了可求解问题的规模。作者希望借助经典网络流思想，用多项式规模的流编码替代SEC，并进一步给出k-hop连通性的紧凑编码，从而降低模型复杂度、扩展可求解规模，并探讨其对分支定界求解性能的实际影响。
analysis.primary_topic: 网络化多智能体系统运动规划与任务分配中的混合整数连通性约束建模
analysis.relation_to_research: 本文与智能优化、生产调度及AI4OR的关联主要是方法层面的迁移价值而非直接应用：其核心是MILP连通性约束的紧凑编码与分支定界复杂度分析，属于数学规划与组合优化建模方向，而非生产调度问题本身。对生产调度研究者而言，可迁移的机制是“用多项式规模的流/网络编码替代指数级组合约束”这一建模思想（推测），例如在需要保证机器-工件-时段关联结构连通性或路径连续性的调度模型中；但迁移需要满足约束语义与连通性定义可被流守恒刻画这一前提。另外，作者明确指出二进制变量减少对解耦二进制与连续变量的学习型MILP求解器（如深度强化学习仅预测二进制变量）具有潜在价值，这与“学习辅助搜索/强化学习辅助混合整数规划求解”的研究方向有明确的概念联系（作者陈述），但本文并未实际验证该设想。
analysis.setting: 研究网络化多智能体系统（MAS）在连续空间中的运动规划与决策问题：多个具有线性动力学（双积分器）的智能体需在存在多面体障碍物的环境中无碰撞地到达目标区域，目标可预先分配或由系统自行分配（区分必须访问与可选奖励目标），同时必须保证智能体间通信网络在规划过程中保持连通。决策对象为每个智能体的状态与输入轨迹、目标分配以及通信图的构造；目标是在燃料消耗与完成时间意义上进行经济机动并兼顾可选目标奖励；关键约束包括状态/输入有界、避障、智能体间避碰、以及标准连通性或k-hop连通性；信息假设为集中式MILP建模并配合滚动时域规划，通信区域被建模为固定边长的正方形；环境为静态障碍但智能体运动动态演化，文中未说明是否存在随机扰动。

analysis.uncertainty: 本文属于多智能体运动规划与MILP连通性建模，与本研究画像中的生产调度、流水车间、分布式制造等具体调度问题存在明显领域距离，相关性评分基于“方法可迁移”而非问题同源，因此评分不易提高到7以上。此外，全文仅提供节选，部分实验细节（如具体节点时限设置、统计指标的完整表格数值、Gurobi版本与硬件条件）未在可见文本中明确给出，故实验相关描述无法补充更精确的数字；k-hop流方法“未转化为平均性能提升”的具体量化差距也不在可见证据内。
analysis.why_recommended: 对关注混合整数建模、约束编码复杂度与分支定界求解性能的研究者具有参考价值：它将经典多商品流思想系统性地引入MAS连通性维护，给出了必要性与充分性证明、渐近复杂度对比表以及随机大规模统计评估，并诚实报告了理论优势未转化为平均性能提升这一负面结果。这种“理论复杂度与实证性能解耦”的分析范式对研究学习辅助MILP求解、二进制变量规模敏感型求解策略以及约束编码选择的工作具有直接的借鉴意义，尤其是作者对未来解耦式学习型求解器可能从二进制变量减少中获益的判断，可启发学习辅助优化方向的研究假设。

paper.abstract: This work investigates the use of flow-based connectivity maintenance constraints in mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) trajectory planning and decision-making models for networked multi-agent systems (MAS). We integrate flow-based encodings for standard and k-hop connectivity into MILP multi-vehicle maneuvering models that are widely used alongside receding horizon planning strategies. Their necessity and sufficiency is demonstrated, guaranteeing full coverage of potential network topologies. The flow formulation for standard connectivity decreases the growth of the required inequality constraints from exponential to polynomial w.r.t. the size of the MAS when compared to the state-of-the-art subtour elimination (SEC) method. The flow-based k-hop connectivity constraints decrease the number of required binary variables and decouple its growth from the number of hops. However, the impact of these formulations in performance is not straightforward due to the introduction of a substantial number of continuous flow optimization variables and, in the case of k-hop connectivity, additional inequality constraints. We investigate this trade-off through a statistical evaluation of costs and optimization times using a conventional branch-and-bound commercial solver and trials performed with randomized environments for increasingly larger MAS. The results show that the flow formulation outperforms SEC in standard connectivity problems, enabling the solutions to be computed for larger MAS considering the imposed optimization time limit. The reduction in number of binary variables enabled by the k-hop flow formulations decreases the theoretical worst-case number of iterations required by the branch-and-bound algorithm to compute the global optimal solution. Our results show that this advantage did not translate into improvements in the average performance when compared to the baseline.
paper.title: Mixed-integer flow formulations for motion planning and decision-making of networked multi-agent systems

analysis.analysis: 作者采用结构化技术综述方式，将文献按强化学习在运筹学中的三种角色组织，并进一步按算法范式分类。对于序贯决策问题，作者使用“问题签名”（动作空间、可观测性、时间跨度、动态性）与强化学习算法及训练方式、基线进行表格化对照；对于组合优化，作者按强化学习范式与架构、所求解组合优化问题、基线、问题规模进行归类，并总结路由问题倾向于策略梯度配合指针或 Transformer 解码器、一般图问题倾向于基于价值方法配合图神经网络编码器、问题规模增大时从指针网络转向 Transformer 等模式；对于数字孪生，作者区分数字孪生作为虚拟训练环境、加速强化学习、以及作为扩展现实分析平台三类用途。
challenges: 无模型强化学习样本效率低，通常需要与环境大量交互才能学习

evidence.claim: 本文是一篇系统综述，将强化学习赋能运筹学分为三种关键角色。
evidence.quote: this paper presents a structured review of three key roles that RL plays in empowering OR: (i) solving sequential decision-making problems in dynamic environments, (ii) serving as an end-to-end solution method or as a component integrated within heuristic and exact OR methods for combinatorial optimization problems, and (iii) facilitating extended reality analysis through integration with digital twin systems.

evidence.claim: 综述的整体目标是利用强化学习的学习能力增强传统运筹算法，提高解质量、计算效率与鲁棒性。
evidence.quote: The overarching goal across these efforts is to leverage the learning capabilities of RL to strengthen traditional OR algorithms, improving solution quality, computational efficiency, and robustness.

evidence.claim: 组合优化研究中存在基线选择不统一、缺乏标准化评估协议的问题。

analysis.insight: 强化学习对运筹学的价值不在于简单替换传统算法，而在于按其与运筹决策结构的耦合方式扮演不同角色：当问题具有离散动作、高可观测性和回合式或离散时间结构时，基于价值的方法天然适配；当路由等问题规模增大时，策略梯度配合指针或 Transformer 解码器更具扩展性；当系统结构已知或样本效率关键时，基于模型的方法可通过内部转移与奖励模型进行规划。综述通过“问题签名—算法范式—训练方式—基线”的对照分类，将方法选择与问题结构、数据可得性和计算资源约束联系起来，从而解释不同整合路径的有效性来源。
limitations: 无模型强化学习样本效率低，需要大量环境交互
基于模型与离线方法样本效率较高，但模型学习、模拟器构建与不确定性量化带来显著训练和工程开销，并面临高维编码器-解码器架构、长时域信用分配、稀疏或延迟奖励等可扩展性挑战
组合优化领域基线选择不统一、缺乏标准化评估协议，跨研究比较困难
无模型与基于模型方法各有适用边界，选择依赖环境性质、数据可用性、计算资源以及安全性、可解释性、规划深度等运行要求
method: 将强化学习赋能运筹学划分为三种关键角色：求解动态环境下的序贯决策问题、作为端到端方法或嵌入启发式与精确运筹方法求解组合优化、与数字孪生集成支持扩展现实分析
对序贯决策文献按问题签名（动作空间离散性、可观测性、时间跨度、动态性）、强化学习方法、训练方式（在线/离线）与基线进行分类比较
对组合优化文献按强化学习范式与架构（策略梯度、指针网络、Transformer、基于价值方法、图神经网络）、所求解问题、基线、问题规模分类，并归纳架构随规模演变的模式
对数字孪生文献区分三类作用：作为强化学习的虚拟训练环境、用于加速强化学习（如建模转移动态与奖励函数）、以及集成扩展现实分析
对比无模型与基于模型强化学习在环境交互方式、样本效率、训练复杂度与适用环境结构上的差异，并讨论离线学习在交通规划与库存控制中的应用
基于上述分析提出未来研究方法论与实践整合的路线图
analysis.motivation: 复杂动态系统中的实时、数据驱动决策需求对传统运筹学方法造成压力；强化学习因其在动态不确定环境下的序贯决策学习能力与计算能力成为一种互补方法。近年将强化学习与运筹学结合以处理动态决策、增强启发式与精确算法、并支持运营系统数字副本的研究不断增多，但整合方式与应用场景多样，缺乏系统且技术细节充分的综述，因此作者撰写此结构化综述并给出未来研究路线图。
analysis.primary_topic: 强化学习与运筹学结合的系统性综述
analysis.relation_to_research: 本文与智能优化、生产调度和人工智能驱动运筹优化直接相关。它系统梳理了强化学习求解动态序贯决策、增强启发式与精确算法求解组合优化、以及与数字孪生集成三类路径，其中组合优化部分涉及的指针网络、Transformer、图神经网络编码、策略梯度与基于价值方法，可直接为柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造和生产运输协同等调度问题中的学习辅助搜索提供方法参考。迁移到生产调度需要满足的条件（推测）：调度问题需被形式化为具有明确动作空间、状态表示、奖励函数和约束处理机制的序贯决策或组合优化问题；若采用端到端方法，需要处理调度中的机器、工序、运输资源等异构图结构并保证约束可行性，而综述本身未对生产调度约束可行性验证作专门实验。
analysis.setting: 本文是一篇技术综述，研究问题是如何系统性地梳理强化学习赋能运筹学的三种角色：在动态不确定环境中求解序贯决策问题、作为端到端方法或嵌入启发式与精确算法中求解组合优化问题、以及与数字孪生系统集成以支持扩展现实分析；决策对象涵盖交通、库存、物流、生产调度等运筹场景中的策略或解；目标是提升解质量、计算效率与鲁棒性；关键约束、信息假设及静态或动态环境的细节在摘要层面未完全说明，正文以分类表格形式给出动作空间、可观测性、时间跨度与动态性等“问题签名”。

analysis.why_recommended: 对研究智能优化与生产调度中如何引入强化学习的研究者，本文提供了按问题结构选择算法范式的对照框架：离散动作、高可观测性、回合式问题适合基于价值方法；大规模路由类问题适合策略梯度配合指针或 Transformer 解码器；图结构问题适合基于价值方法配合图神经网络。文中对训练方式（在线/离线）、基线与问题规模的归纳，以及无模型与基于模型方法的样本效率和工程开销权衡，可直接用于设计学习辅助搜索的实验方案、选择公平基线和评估标准化，并帮助识别数字孪生作为调度仿真训练环境的可能路径。

paper.abstract: The growing demand for real-time, data-driven decision-making in complex and dynamic systems is placing increasing pressure on traditional Operational Research (OR) methodologies. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a complementary approach, offering strong learning and computational capabilities for sequential decision-making in dynamic and uncertain environments. Recent research shows an increasing interest in integrating RL with OR to address dynamic decision-making problems, enhance heuristic and exact methods for combinatorial optimization, and support the development of digital replicas of operational systems. The overarching goal across these efforts is to leverage the learning capabilities of RL to strengthen traditional OR algorithms, improving solution quality, computational efficiency, and robustness. Given the diversity of integration approaches and application settings, there is a clear need for a systematic and technically detailed review of how RL empowers OR methods. To address this gap, this paper presents a structured review of three key roles that RL plays in empowering OR: (i) solving sequential decision-making problems in dynamic environments, (ii) serving as an end-to-end solution method or as a component integrated within heuristic and exact OR methods for combinatorial optimization problems, and (iii) facilitating extended reality analysis through integration with digital twin systems. We critically synthesize recent advances across these roles, highlighting their advantages, implementation requirements, limitations, and challenges. Finally, based on these insights, we outline a roadmap for future research to further advance the methodological and practical integration of RL and OR.
paper.title: Reinforcement Learning in Operational Research: A Technical Review and Practical Roadmap

analysis.analysis: 作者将目标优化与元层算法设计形式化为两个耦合的序贯决策过程，目标优化被建模为马尔可夫决策过程，状态 s_t 概括已评估解、近期进展与剩余预算，动作 a_t 给出下一步候选解，且假设 s_t 充分概括相关历史。在此框架下，算法 π 被表示为状态到动作的映射，在线设计则在每阶段根据 s_t 合成新算法。作者还通过附录中的性能差分析给出命题 1，用设计空间误差、表示误差和合成误差上界刻画 OnDesign 与理想在线设计器之间的期望终端效用差，并据此将 State Analysis 和 SAG Evolution 对应到当前与后续状态表示的决策相关信息，将 Multi-Agent Deliberation 对应到算法覆盖与合成。

analysis.insight: 论文的核心洞察在于：算法设计不应是一次性的离线产物，而应作为优化过程中随状态变化而在线更新的决策变量。其有效性来源于将程序合成嵌入目标优化回路：执行当前生成的算法既推进搜索又产生反馈，该反馈同时用于下一阶段算法合成和运行时证据解读方式的修正，从而在无需单独离线预训练的情况下，使设计空间超越预定义参数、算子或策略，缓解离线设计范式下设计与执行脱节以及固定算法难以适配状态演化的问题。

未来工作将把评估扩展到这些场景。
method: 将目标优化与算法设计视为耦合的序贯决策过程，状态 s_t 包含已评估解、近期进展与剩余评估预算，动作 a_t 指定下一步候选解，算法被表示为由状态到动作的映射。
提出在线 LLM 基 AAD 范式：在每一阶段由 LLM 智能体从当前优化状态合成具有新行为逻辑的算法，执行该算法推进搜索并产生反馈，用于后续设计，无需单独离线算法预训练。
提出 OnDesign 多智能体框架，包含 State Analysis、Multi-Agent Deliberation 和 SAG Evolution 三个模块。
State Analysis 负责从当前优化状态中提取决策相关信息；Multi-Agent Deliberation 协调相互竞争的设计视角以合成可执行算法；SAG Evolution 利用执行反馈修正运行时证据的解读方式，并影响后续算法合成。
执行反馈同时用于两部分：生成后续算法，以及更新用于解释运行时证据的指导准则。
analysis.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的自动化算法设计大多采用离线范式，算法设计与目标优化在时间上分离，部署后算法固定不变；而传统自适应优化器虽能响应优化状态变化，其调整仅限于预定义的参数、算子或策略，无法改变底层算法逻辑。因此在优化状态动态演化时，固定部署的算法可能不再适配，需要将算法本身视为状态依赖的决策变量，在目标优化运行中在线合成新算法。
analysis.primary_topic: 大语言模型驱动的在线自动化算法设计与多智能体框架
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文与智能优化和 AI4OR 中“学习辅助搜索/算法自动设计”方向直接相关，其核心是把算法本身作为在线决策变量，由 LLM 智能体根据优化状态合成新可执行算法，并以执行反馈驱动后续设计。这与研究画像中关注的神经网络辅助求解、强化学习/多智能体优化、学习与搜索结合等机制有明确的概念联系；但该论文面向的是通用黑箱优化（贝叶斯优化、连续与混合变量进化优化），并未涉及柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造、生产运输协同或动态扰动等具体生产调度问题。推测若要迁移到生产调度，需要将优化状态替换为调度状态表示（如机器、工序、运输资源、扰动事件与剩余计算预算），并设计可执行的调度算子或求解策略合成模板，同时验证约束可行性、解质量和公平计算预算下的泛化能力；这些迁移路径属于推测，并非作者结论。
analysis.setting: 论文研究黑箱优化中的在线自动化算法设计问题：决策对象是在优化过程每一阶段由大语言模型智能体合成的新可执行算法，目标是在给定评估预算下最大化终端效用（搜索性能），关键约束是保持解的可行性与预算限制（材料未说明具体约束处理机制），信息假设是优化状态 s_t 可充分概括已评估解、近期进展和剩余预算等历史信息并满足马尔可夫性，环境为单目标、维度最高 30 的静态黑箱优化场景（材料未说明动态扰动或分布式约束）。
